66420.recognize_zh: 中倍率骨髓抹片中，許多早期紅系與顆粒球前驅細胞的細胞質內有清楚的小空泡 (cytoplasmic vacuoles)，同時成熟顆粒球偏少；這種紅系與骨髓系同時空泡化是銅缺乏 (copper deficiency) 的線索。
features: Cellular aspirate with a mixed population dominated by early erythroid precursors and immature granulocytes (left-shifted)
Distinct small cytoplasmic vacuoles in many proerythroblasts and in promyelocytes/myelocytes
Late erythroblasts with dark, condensed nuclei, some with irregular nuclear outlines
Relatively few mature segmented neutrophils
20× objective limits assessment of fine dysplastic detail and ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on this stain
66420.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at intermediate magnification is cellular and shows left-shifted erythropoiesis and granulopoiesis. Numerous proerythroblasts and immature granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes and myelocytes) contain prominent cytoplasmic vacuoles, while mature neutrophils are relatively reduced. Late erythroblasts show condensed nuclei with some irregular contours. Blasts are not obviously increased in this field. In the clinical setting of zinc supplementation and jejunostomy feeding, the findings are consistent with acquired copper deficiency; serum copper and ceruloplasmin and an iron stain for ring sideroblasts are recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS shows clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities, dysplastic megakaryocytes and persistent changes, whereas copper deficiency vacuolation reverses with copper repletion and serum copper is low.
Drug- or alcohol-induced vacuolation of precursors is morphologically identical, so distinction relies on exposure history and normal serum copper.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts and often TP53 mutation, not a reversible mixed-lineage vacuolation.
Burkitt cells are uniform medium-sized lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, not erythroid and granulocytic precursors.

66228.recognize_zh: 中央一顆淋巴球體積比紅血球大，細胞核偏心、橢圓且染色質成塊，旁邊有豐富淡藍灰色細胞質，內含數顆粗大的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；需靠持續淋巴球增多與流式細胞儀證實 T-LGL 白血病。
features: Large lymphocyte, about 1.5-2 times red cell diameter
Round-to-oval eccentric nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and no visible nucleoli
Moderate to abundant pale, lightly basophilic cytoplasm
Several coarse azurophilic (magenta) granules clustered in the cytoplasm
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; scattered platelets
66228.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granular lymphocyte with a round-to-oval nucleus, mature clumped chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm containing several coarse azurophilic granules. Red cells show no significant morphologic abnormality and platelets are present. A single large granular lymphocyte is not diagnostic in itself; with a persistent absolute LGL expansion, as reported here, flow cytometric demonstration of a clonal CD3+CD8+CD57+ T-cell population supports T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive LGL expansion (viral infection, post-transplant, rheumatoid arthritis)
ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are morphologically identical, so persistence over 6 months, TCR clonality or TRBC1 restriction and STAT3 mutation are needed to separate them.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGLs look the same but are surface CD3 negative with CD16/CD56 expression and lack TCR rearrangement.
Hairy cells have circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections, oval to bean-shaped nuclei and no azurophilic granules.
Aggressive NK cells show immature chromatin, nucleoli and pleomorphism in an acutely ill patient, unlike this mature-appearing granular lymphocyte.

66164.recognize_zh: 中倍（20x）PAS 染色的骨髓切片，左上方成片的大型細胞有豐富淡粉紅至洋紅色、帶纖維條紋的細胞質與小而偏心的核，即 Gaucher 細胞；右側為深藍色核的造血細胞與洋紅色的巨核細胞。此倍率下 PAS 對比較淡，外觀接近 H&E。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale pink to magenta, finely fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei (Gaucher cells)
Gaucher cells form a confluent aggregate at the upper left and scattered clusters elsewhere
Adjacent residual hematopoietic cells with dark blue nuclei, including granulocytic precursors and PAS-positive megakaryocytes
Bony trabecular fragments at the lower field
Tinctorial contrast is modest at this magnification, so the pattern resembles H&E
66164.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section stained with PAS shows sheets and clusters of large histiocytic cells with abundant pale pink, finely striated cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, interspersed with residual hematopoietic elements including megakaryocytes. The storage cells show cytoplasmic PAS positivity, which is diastase resistant in Gaucher cells. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cell infiltration of the marrow, with confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but occur with the underlying disease and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble vacuolated cytoplasm that is weakly PAS positive, rather than fibrillary wrinkled cytoplasm.
Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes can mimic Gaucher cells on PAS but are acid-fast positive.
Mast cells are smaller, spindled, tryptase and CD117 positive, and lack abundant striated PAS-positive cytoplasm.

65972.recognize_zh: 大型異型細胞細胞質豐富且含空泡，核被擠向一側呈新月形（signet ring），外觀似腺癌；但背景有淋巴球、嗜中性球與嗜伊紅球等混合發炎細胞，免疫染色 CD30、CD15 陽性、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45 與 EMA 陰性，支持典型何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A: large atypical cells in small clusters with abundant pale to vacuolated cytoplasm
Eccentric, crescent-shaped compressed nuclei giving signet ring morphology (panel B collage)
Mixed inflammatory background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, granulocytes including eosinophils
Panels C–D: large cells positive for CD30 and CD15 with membranous/Golgi-type staining
Panels E–F: weak PAX5 compared with strong background B cells, and MUM1 positivity
Panels G–H: large cells negative for CD45 (background lymphocytes positive) and EMA negative
65972.describe_en: Biopsy of a supraclavicular mass shows small clusters of large atypical cells with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm and eccentric, crescent-shaped nuclei resembling signet ring cells, set in a mixed inflammatory background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes, and granulocytes. By immunohistochemistry, the atypical cells are positive for CD30, CD15, MUM1, and weakly for PAX5, and negative for CD45 and EMA. This immunoprofile excludes carcinoma and supports a Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell phenotype. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma with unusual signet ring cell morphology.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is pancytokeratin/EMA positive and mucicarmine positive, whereas these cells are keratin, EMA and mucin negative with CD30/CD15 and weak PAX5.
ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 with EMA and often ALK positivity, lacks PAX5, and has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei.

ddx.dx: Signet ring variant of follicular or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These express CD45 and strong CD20/PAX5 with OCT2/BOB1, whereas this case is CD45, CD20, OCT2 and BOB1 negative.
Histiocytes have bland nuclei and are CD68/CD163 positive and CD30/CD15 negative.

65972.stain: H&E; IHC CD30, CD15, PAX5, MUM1, CD45, EMA

65716.recognize_zh: 視野中可見大型血小板：右側兩顆（一顆淡染含顆粒、一顆位於紅血球旁）直徑接近小紅血球，明顯大於其他正常大小血小板；嗜中性球無 Döhle 樣包涵體，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群的巨大血小板。
features: Giant platelets approaching the diameter of small red cells, with central granulomere and pale hyalomere
Coexisting normal-sized platelets, giving marked platelet size heterogeneity
Platelets appear sparse in this field
Neutrophil with multilobed nucleus and normal granulation; no Döhle-like inclusions
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes), consistent with smear artifact
65716.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows platelets of markedly variable size, including giant platelets approaching the diameter of small red cells, with normally granulated central granulomeres. Platelets appear sparse in this field. The neutrophil shows a multilobed nucleus without Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions. Red cells show crenation consistent with artifact. In a patient with a lifelong bleeding tendency, findings are consistent with a giant platelet disorder such as Bernard-Soulier syndrome; confirmation requires absent ristocetin-induced aggregation and reduced GPIb-IX-V by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders also show giant platelets but neutrophils contain blue Döhle-like inclusions, which are absent here.
ITP shows mildly enlarged young platelets but rarely red-cell-sized giant forms, and ristocetin aggregation and GPIb expression are normal.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular on Wright stain, whereas these platelets retain purple granules.

ddx.dx: Pseudothrombocytopenia with platelet satellitism or clumping
ddx.vs: EDTA-induced clumping shows aggregates of normal-sized platelets rather than individual giant platelets.

64948.recognize_zh: 低倍下抹片尾端（tail end）可見數個大小不一、無結構的淡藍色團塊沉積物（箭頭處最明顯），周圍為散在的白血球與紅血球，這種淡藍色無定形沉積提示冷凝球蛋白（cryoglobulin）在室溫下沉澱。
features: Low-power view of the feathered tail end of a blood smear
Several large, amorphous, pale blue to lilac globular deposits (arrow), larger than leukocytes
Deposits are homogeneous and acellular, some with a few trapped cells or granules
Scattered leukocytes and red cells, with red cell clumping at the thicker edge
Individual cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification
64948.describe_en: Low-power examination of the tail end of the peripheral blood smear shows multiple amorphous, homogeneous, pale blue extracellular deposits of varying size, the largest exceeding the diameter of adjacent leukocytes. The deposits lack internal cellular structure and are distinct from platelet clumps. Leukocytes and red cells are scattered in the background, but detailed cytology is not evaluable at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of precipitated cryoglobulins; correlation with cryoglobulin testing on a sample kept at 37 C and serum protein studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet aggregates are granular purple clusters of individual platelets rather than smooth homogeneous pale blue material.
Stain deposit is crystalline or dark granular and lies in a different focal plane, rather than forming pale blue globules.
Cold agglutinins produce clumps of red cells, whereas these deposits are acellular protein.
Fibrin forms thin fibrillar strands with entrapped platelets rather than rounded amorphous globules.

65780.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有多顆雙核漿細胞（binucleate plasma cell）：兩個圓形偏位核並排，細胞質豐富深藍並有核旁淡染區，且同一視野內漿細胞數量多、大小不一，提示腫瘤性漿細胞增生。
features: Increased plasma cells, several of them binucleate with two round, similar-sized nuclei
Eccentric nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin; small nucleoli in some cells
Abundant deep blue cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear hof
Mild variation in plasma cell size, including large forms
Background red cells with mild stacking
65780.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increased population of plasma cells, including multiple binucleate forms. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof, with mild variation in cell size. Background red cells show mild stacking. Findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma; quantification and kappa/lambda clonality assessment are required.

ddx.vs: Occasional binucleate plasma cells can be reactive, but reactive plasma cells are fewer, uniformly mature and polytypic.
Osteoblasts occur in clusters and have a pale zone separated from the nucleus rather than a perinuclear hof.
Plasmablasts are larger with fine chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and a high N:C ratio.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells rather than a pure plasma cell population.

65652.recognize_zh: 中央的嗜中性球核分成 6–7 個分離的圓形小葉，排列成一簇，細胞質淡粉紅；一顆細胞就有 ≥6 葉，符合分葉過多，背景紅血球大致正常大小。
features: Single neutrophil with six to seven discrete small rounded nuclear lobes
Dense, condensed chromatin in each lobe
Moderate pale pink cytoplasm with fine granules
Cell of approximately normal neutrophil size
Background red cells mostly normocytic with some oval and stomatocyte-like forms; few platelets
65652.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with six to seven discrete nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin, within a cell of approximately normal size and pale finely granular cytoplasm. Background red cells are mostly normocytic, with occasional oval forms and cells with slit-like central pallor that may be artifactual. Platelets are present in small numbers. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation; correlation with MCV, vitamin B12, folate, and medication history is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia pairs hypersegmented neutrophils with macro-ovalocytes and raised MCV, which require confirmation on the full smear and CBC.
The hereditary trait is diagnosed by persistent hypersegmentation with normal vitamin levels and family studies.
Apoptotic neutrophils show dense round nuclear fragments without connecting filaments and often hypereosinophilic cytoplasm.
Antimetabolite drugs produce identical morphology and are distinguished only by history.

65588.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片組合：臉部、額頭、軀幹多處紫紅色結節與斑塊，並有部分照片顯示病灶消退；年長男性合併這種瘀青樣紫色皮膚病灶，要想到 BPDCN。這不是顯微鏡形態學圖片。
features: Eight-panel composite of clinical photographs of an older man
Multiple violaceous to purplish-red nodules and plaques on the face, forehead, and scalp margin
Numerous disseminated erythematous to violaceous papules and nodules on the chest and abdomen
Panels showing regression of lesions with residual hyperpigmentation and erythema, suggesting response to therapy
No histologic or cytologic information in this image
65588.describe_en: Composite clinical photographs show multiple violaceous, bruise-like nodules and plaques involving the face, forehead, and trunk, with disseminated erythematous papules over the chest and abdomen. Other panels show marked regression of the lesions with residual hyperpigmentation and erythema, consistent with treatment response. Although the violaceous, bruise-like cutaneous nodules are characteristic of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, the diagnosis requires skin or marrow biopsy demonstrating CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCL1+ blasts.

65460.recognize_zh: 這顆單核球具有摺疊的核與灰藍色細胞質，但細胞質中布滿粗大的紫色顆粒，比一般單核球的細顆粒明顯得多，這是單核球中的 Alder-Reilly 包涵體。
features: Monocyte-sized cell with a folded nucleus
Gray-blue cytoplasm filled with coarse purple granular inclusions
Granules overlie the nucleus and extend to the cell periphery
No cytoplasmic vacuoles or phagocytosed material
Background red cells unremarkable
65460.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monocyte with a folded nucleus and gray-blue cytoplasm containing numerous coarse purple granular inclusions that overlie the nucleus. No vacuoles, organisms, or phagocytosed material are seen. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly inclusions in a monocyte, suggestive of a mucopolysaccharidosis.

ddx.vs: Normal monocyte granules are fine and dust-like, not coarse and dense purple inclusions.
Immature monocytic cells have finer chromatin and nucleoli, whereas this cell has mature folded nuclear chromatin.
Phagocytosed material is irregular and usually within vacuoles, not evenly distributed uniform granules.

65524.recognize_zh: 四格周邊血抹片：A、B 可見紅血球成團凝集（箭頭頭）並混有許多橢圓形紅血球（箭頭），而且看不到多染性（polychromasia）網狀紅血球；C 為父親的抹片，也有很多橢圓形紅血球；D 為治療後，凝集消失只剩橢圓形紅血球。凝集加上缺乏網狀紅血球，指向 parvovirus B19 誘發的自體免疫溶血；家族性橢圓形紅血球則是遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症。
features: Panels A–B: irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells (arrowheads), distinct from linear rouleaux
Numerous elliptocytes and oval red cells (arrows) mixed with spherocytic/dense forms
No polychromatophilic red cells despite severe anemia (reticulocytopenia)
Panel C (father): many elliptocytes without agglutination
Panel D (post-treatment): agglutination resolved with persistent elliptocytes; red cells otherwise normochromic
65524.describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood smears. The patient's smears at presentation show a markedly reduced red cell density with irregular red cell agglutinates and numerous elliptocytes, without polychromasia; leukocytes and platelets appear unremarkable. The father's smear shows prominent elliptocytosis without agglutination, and the patient's follow-up smear shows resolution of agglutination with persistent elliptocytes. In conjunction with a positive DAT, positive parvovirus B19 serology and an SPTB variant, findings are consistent with parvovirus B19-associated autoimmune hemolytic anemia with reticulocytopenia superimposed on hereditary elliptocytosis.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear coin-like stacks caused by increased plasma proteins, whereas agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional clumps that do not disperse with saline.
Cold agglutinin disease shows agglutination that disperses on warming and a DAT positive for C3d only, while this case is IgG and C3d positive.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 pure red cell aplasia without hemolysis
ddx.vs: Transient aplastic crisis shows reticulocytopenia but no agglutination and a negative DAT.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or thalassemia with pencil cells
ddx.vs: Pencil cells are hypochromic and microcytic with target cells, whereas these elliptocytes are normochromic and familial.

65396.recognize_zh: 多格影像中漿細胞核偏位、染色質粗、細胞質深藍帶核周淡染區，有的聚成一小群，並見雙核漿細胞，背景紅血球疊成錢串狀，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Increased plasma cells, including a cluster of six atypical plasma cells
Eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and perinuclear hof in basophilic cytoplasm
Binucleated forms and cells with irregular cytoplasmic outlines or blebs
Some plasma cells with lighter pink-purple cytoplasm
Background rouleaux formation
65396.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate composite shows numerous plasma cells, singly and in a cohesive-appearing cluster, with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Binucleated forms and cells with irregular cytoplasmic blebs are present, with occasional admixed neutrophils. The red cells in the background are arranged in rouleaux. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, mature, scattered around vessels rather than clustered, and polytypic.
Carcinoma clusters show nuclear molding and cohesive sheets without hof, and are cytokeratin-positive.
Osteoblasts also have an eccentric nucleus and a pale zone, but the pale zone is away from the nucleus, cells are larger and occur in rows in young patients.

65204.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中小型單形淋巴球瀰漫浸潤並圍繞殘存生發中心，cyclin D1 核陽性細胞形成套區環狀帶，而其外側擴張的邊緣區由 IRTA1 陽性、cyclin D1 陰性的 B 細胞組成，顯示為套細胞淋巴瘤合併反應性邊緣區擴張。
features: Lymph node with diffuse infiltrate of small monotonous lymphocytes with slightly irregular nuclei around residual germinal centers; scattered pink histiocytes
CD20 diffusely positive in the infiltrate
Cyclin D1 nuclear positivity in a mantle zone distribution surrounding cyclin D1-negative germinal centers
IRTA1 membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in the outer marginal zone B cells, sparing germinal center and mantle
Triple stain: CD10 (green) germinal center, cyclin D1 (red) mantle cells and IRTA1 (brown) marginal zone cells in mutually exclusive compartments
65204.describe_en: Lymph node biopsy shows effacement by a diffuse proliferation of small, monotonous lymphocytes with scattered epithelioid histiocytes, surrounding residual germinal centers. The lymphoid cells are CD20 positive, and nuclear cyclin D1 highlights an expanded mantle zone rim around cyclin D1-negative germinal centers. An expanded marginal zone external to the mantle is composed of IRTA1-positive B cells, which are cyclin D1 negative on triple immunostaining. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with a reactive IRTA1-positive marginal zone expansion.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma with marginal zone differentiation
ddx.vs: A neoplastic MZ component would co-express cyclin D1 with IRTA1, whereas here IRTA1 and cyclin D1 are mutually exclusive.
NMZL cells are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative, whereas the dominant mantle-pattern population here is cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive.
Reactive mantle cells are cyclin D1 negative and polytypic, lacking the diffuse cyclin D1-positive infiltrate.
SLL shows proliferation centers and is CD23 and LEF1 positive but cyclin D1 negative (except in proliferation centers weakly).

65204.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, cyclin D1, IRTA1, CD10 triple

65076.recognize_zh: 抹片中央可見數顆大型異常淋巴樣細胞，核大、偏心，細胞質豐富且呈深藍色，周邊散在成熟嗜中性球與小淋巴球；標題所述的吞噬紅血球在此解析度下並不明確，只能看到大細胞緊貼紅血球。
features: Cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells, several times the size of red cells, with eccentric round nuclei
Moderately dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not well resolved at this magnification
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, one cell with pale perinuclear zone
Red cells closely apposed to the large cells; definite intracytoplasmic engulfed red cells are not clearly resolved
Background of mature neutrophils, small lymphocytes, platelets and a large granular smudged/degenerated cell
65076.describe_en: The May-Grunwald-Giemsa-stained smear shows a small cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei, dispersed chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, in a background of mature neutrophils, small lymphocytes and platelets. Red cells lie closely adjacent to the large cells, but unequivocal intracytoplasmic erythrophagocytosis cannot be confirmed at this image resolution. In the clinical context of CLL, the large basophilic cells are suggestive of large B-cell lymphoma (Richter transformation); tissue biopsy and immunophenotyping are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Benign histiocytes have low N:C ratio, bland reniform nuclei and pale vacuolated cytoplasm with engulfed cells, rather than basophilic cytoplasm with atypical lymphoid nuclei; CD68/CD163 vs CD20 resolves it.
Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a single central nucleolus and moderate pale cytoplasm, smaller than these large basophilic cells.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Eccentric nuclei with basophilic cytoplasm overlap morphologically; CD138/MUM1 positivity with CD20 negativity favors plasmablastic lineage.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with gray cytoplasm and fine vacuoles, and immunoblasts occur singly in reactive settings rather than as a clonal atypical population.

65140.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中滿是大型母細胞，核圓到有凹陷或摺疊、染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質中等、藍灰色並布滿許多小空泡；中間還有一個含粗大深紫顆粒的細胞（疑似異常嗜酸性前驅細胞）。體液中出現大量母細胞即提示白血病性腹水，細胞型態與顆粒符合具單核球分化、inv(16) 的 AML。
features: Densely cellular fluid preparation composed almost entirely of large blasts, 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte
High N:C ratio with round, indented, folded or cleaved nuclei
Fine dispersed chromatin with conspicuous nucleoli in many cells
Moderate grey-blue to basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles
Occasional cell with coarse dark purple granules, possibly an abnormal eosinophil precursor
Proteinaceous pink background with scattered RBCs; no mesothelial cell clusters evident
65140.describe_en: Cytospin/smear of ascitic fluid is highly cellular and composed predominantly of large blasts with high N:C ratios, round to folded or cleaved nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate, grey-blue and prominently vacuolated. A rare cell contains coarse dark purple granules, which may represent an abnormal eosinophil precursor. Reactive mesothelial cells and mature inflammatory cells are inconspicuous. Findings are consistent with leukemic ascites by acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic features, in keeping with the reported AML with inv(16).

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have dense two-toned cytoplasm with a peripheral lacy skirt, central round nuclei and form windows between cells, unlike discohesive vacuolated blasts.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and lipid vacuoles but have round nuclei, multiple small nucleoli, and a CD10+/MYC-rearranged B-cell phenotype without myeloid markers.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with mucin vacuoles and are keratin/MOC31-positive rather than CD33/CD117/MPO-positive.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving peritoneum
ddx.vs: Large lymphoma cells have coarser chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm and express B-cell markers on flow cytometry instead of myeloid/monocytic antigens.

65012.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見中大型細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質含紫紅色顆粒且邊緣不規則，左格三顆聚在一起；在此解析度下看不清楚描述中的 Auer 小體，因此只能判定為符合治療中急性前骨髓細胞性白血病（APL）的異常芽細胞/前骨髓細胞。
features: Medium-to-large immature myeloid cells, singly (right) and in a group of three (left)
High N:C ratio with round to slightly folded nuclei and finely dispersed chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine purple-red granules and irregular, frayed cell borders
No definite Auer rods or faggot cells can be resolved at this image resolution
Background red cells include target cells, stomatocyte-like forms and scattered crenated cells; platelets sparse
65012.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered medium-to-large immature myeloid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and granular cytoplasm with irregular borders. Nucleoli and Auer rods cannot be confidently resolved at this magnification and resolution. Background red cells show target cells and minor poikilocytosis, and platelets appear decreased. In a patient with acute promyelocytic leukemia under treatment (e.g., ATRA/arsenic), the findings are compatible with circulating abnormal blasts/promyelocytes with therapy-related changes; the Auer rod described cannot be verified in this image.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or butterfly-shaped nuclei with sparse granules and high WBC; PML::RARA testing is definitive in both.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation or monocytic AML
ddx.vs: Non-APL AML lacks faggot cells and bundles of Auer rods and is PML::RARA negative, often HLA-DR positive.
During ATRA therapy, cells mature toward myelocytes and neutrophils with nuclear indentation and secondary granules, a clinical-temporal rather than purely morphologic distinction.
G-CSF produces promyelocytes with coarse toxic granules and a full maturation spectrum without Auer rods or coagulopathy.

64820.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被大量泡沫狀、空泡狀細胞質的組織球與小淋巴球取代，其間散在細胞核不規則、染色質疏鬆的中至大型異型細胞；背景反應細胞遮蔽腫瘤細胞，是淋巴組織球變異型 ALCL 的典型陷阱。
features: Diffuse effacement by a mixed infiltrate rich in histiocytes with abundant pale, foamy to vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous small mature lymphocytes with dark, irregular nuclei in the background
Scattered medium to large atypical cells with irregular to indented vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli, partly obscured by histiocytes
Classic horseshoe/reniform hallmark cells not readily identified at this magnification
Occasional small eosinophilic fragments/vessels; no granulomas or necrosis seen
64820.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse mixed infiltrate composed predominantly of histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and numerous small lymphocytes. On closer inspection, scattered medium to large atypical cells with irregular, vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli are interspersed and partially masked by the reactive histiocytes. Well-formed granulomas and Reed-Sternberg cells are not identified in this field. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD30 and ALK positivity, often highlighting perivascular atypical cells), the findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive, lymphohistiocytic pattern.

ddx.vs: Reactive processes lack the atypical medium-to-large cells, and CD30/ALK immunostains are negative, whereas they highlight the scattered neoplastic cells in lymphohistiocytic ALCL.
The scattered large cells are CD20+/PAX5+ B cells with CD30 and ALK negative, rather than CD30+ ALK+ cells with loss of pan-T-cell markers.
cHL shows Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells with huge inclusion-like nucleoli, eosinophils and plasma cells, and is PAX5 weak+/CD15+ and ALK-negative.
Lennert lymphoma has epithelioid histiocyte clusters with small atypical CD8+ T cells and lacks uniform strong CD30 and ALK expression.

64500.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織被一片瀰漫性、細胞間距均勻的淋巴細胞浸潤取代，每顆圓形至卵圓形小核周圍都有一圈透明細胞質，形成「荷包蛋樣」（fried egg）外觀，並夾雜外滲紅血球，符合毛細胞白血病。
features: Diffuse to interstitial infiltrate of small-to-medium mononuclear cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Round, oval to slightly indented bland nuclei evenly spaced by abundant clear to pale cytoplasm ('fried egg' appearance)
Absence of nucleoli and mitoses; nuclei do not touch each other
Scattered extravasated red cells within the infiltrate and occasional residual megakaryocytes
Adjacent bony trabecula; fat spaces interspersed within the involved marrow
64500.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a diffuse to interstitial infiltrate replacing much of the normal hematopoietic tissue, composed of monotonous small-to-medium cells with bland round to oval or slightly indented nuclei widely and evenly separated by abundant clear cytoplasm, imparting a 'fried egg' appearance. Scattered extravasated red cells and a few residual megakaryocytes are present, and nucleoli and mitoses are not evident. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by immunohistochemistry (CD20, annexin A1, cyclin D1, BRAF V600E) and reticulin stain is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mast cell infiltrates form paratrabecular or perivascular spindled aggregates with eosinophils and fibrosis and are CD117/tryptase positive, rather than an evenly spaced diffuse B-cell infiltrate.
Aplastic marrow is fat-rich with scattered residual lymphocytes and plasma cells, whereas here clear-cytoplasm cells form a cohesive CD20+ infiltrate that is often underestimated as hypocellularity.
SMZL typically shows intrasinusoidal and nodular infiltrates of cells with less abundant clear cytoplasm and is annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.
These show a predominantly intrasinusoidal pattern with less cytoplasmic clearing and lack annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.

64564.recognize_zh: 單一個比周圍紅血球大很多的嗜酸性球，雙葉核，細胞質顆粒稀疏、分布不均，局部呈淡藍色無顆粒區，符合體積增大且低顆粒化的異常嗜酸性球。
features: Enlarged eosinophil, roughly two to three times the red cell diameter
Bilobed nucleus with coarse chromatin
Reduced, unevenly distributed orange-purple granules
Patchy agranular pale blue cytoplasm and a small cytoplasmic clear area
Background red cells normochromic with scattered platelets
64564.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows a single enlarged eosinophil with a bilobed nucleus. The cytoplasm contains a reduced number of unevenly distributed granules with patchy agranular, pale blue areas. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a dysplastic, hypogranular eosinophil, which in the appropriate context supports a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia.

ddx.vs: Normal eosinophils are similar in size to neutrophils and have cytoplasm densely and evenly packed with orange granules.
Myelocytes have a round non-lobulated nucleus, whereas this cell shows a bilobed mature nucleus.
Toxic granules are dark blue-purple and fine without orange eosinophilic granules.

64436.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大型、多形、成群聚集的上皮樣細胞，細胞質淡藍且有空泡，明顯大於周圍造血細胞；切片中骨髓被片狀的高度多形上皮樣細胞取代（箭頭），CD31 瀰漫陽性，證實為轉移性血管肉瘤。
features: Panel A (aspirate): cohesive clusters of large pleomorphic epithelioid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Tumor cells are several times larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells; a single large atypical cell is shown in the inset
Background erythroid-predominant trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes
Panel B (core biopsy): hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of highly pleomorphic epithelioid cells with slit-like spaces and extravasated red cells (arrow)
Panel B inset: diffuse strong CD31 positivity of the infiltrate
64436.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows cohesive clusters of large, pleomorphic epithelioid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei and moderate pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm, set in a background of erythroid-predominant trilineage hematopoiesis. The core biopsy is hypercellular and extensively replaced by sheets of highly pleomorphic epithelioid cells with scattered slit-like spaces and extravasated red blood cells. The neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD31, and CD34 was also positive. In a patient with known angiosarcoma and new cytopenias with a leukoerythroblastic picture, findings are consistent with metastatic angiosarcoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters look similar on aspirate but are cytokeratin-positive and CD31/ERG-negative, whereas epithelioid angiosarcoma is CD31/CD34/ERG-positive (and may be focally keratin-positive).

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia or megakaryocytic proliferation
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts can cluster and show cytoplasmic blebs, but they are CD61/CD42b-positive and lack vascular spaces or cohesive epithelioid growth.
ALCL cells can be cohesive and pleomorphic but are CD30+ and CD45/T-cell marker-positive, and negative for CD31 and ERG.
Melanoma shows prominent macronucleoli, occasional pigment and SOX10/S100/Melan-A positivity rather than endothelial markers.

64372.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭所指的淋巴樣細胞為中到大型，核呈摺疊、凹陷或裂開狀（cleaved/indented），細胞質較嗜鹼性，混在正常的顆粒球系細胞之間，在濾泡性淋巴瘤背景下提示骨髓侵犯。
features: Atypical lymphoid cells of intermediate to large size (arrows) with moderate N:C ratio
Irregular nuclear contours with folding, indentation and clefts
Relatively fine to slightly coarse chromatin with inconspicuous to variably visible nucleoli
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with a pale perinuclear zone
Admixed background granulocytic precursors, segmented neutrophils, an eosinophil and a few small lymphocytes
64372.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered atypical lymphoid cells (arrows) that are intermediate to large in size with irregular, folded and indented to cleaved nuclear contours, relatively dispersed chromatin, variably visible nucleoli and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm. These cells are admixed with maturing granulocytic elements, an eosinophil and small lymphocytes. The cytomorphology is suggestive of marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+ monotypic B cells) and trephine biopsy with paratrabecular aggregates is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are small with very high N:C ratio, homogeneous chromatin and scant cytoplasm without clefted nuclei, and show a maturation spectrum by flow cytometry.
Mantle cells are small to intermediate with irregular nuclei but are CD5+/cyclin D1+ and CD10-, requiring immunophenotyping rather than morphology to separate.
DLBCL cells are larger, often with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, and form sheets rather than scattered cells.
Monocytic cells have gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and lacy chromatin, and are CD14/CD64-positive rather than B-cell markers.

64180.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中可見兩端尖細的鐮刀狀與船形紅血球（sickle／boat cells），加上多個靶形紅血球（target cells），且許多紅血球內含深紫色圓點狀的 Howell-Jolly 小體（其中一顆紅血球含多顆），反映鐮刀型貧血合併功能性無脾。
features: Sickle cells and boat-shaped (oat) cells with tapered or pointed ends
Target cells scattered throughout
Numerous Howell-Jolly bodies: single small round dense purple inclusions, with one red cell containing multiple
Anisopoikilocytosis with a few irregularly contracted cells
Small platelets and platelet clumps in the background
64180.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked poikilocytosis with numerous sickle and boat-shaped cells and scattered target cells. Many red cells contain Howell-Jolly bodies, including one cell with multiple inclusions, indicating absent splenic filtering function. Platelets are present. Findings are consistent with sickle cell anemia (HbSS) with functional hyposplenism (autosplenectomy); hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC confirms the genotype.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows fewer classic sickle cells and characteristic HbC crystals (straight-edged, 'Washington monument' forms) with prominent target cells, and splenic function may be retained.
HbS/beta-thalassemia shows more microcytosis and hypochromia; separation requires MCV and HPLC (HbA2 and HbA levels).
Elliptocytes have rounded, blunt ends with parallel sides and no Howell-Jolly bodies, unlike pointed sickle cells.

ddx.dx: Pappenheimer bodies or platelets overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are multiple fine peripheral granules (iron-positive), and overlying platelets are granular, whereas Howell-Jolly bodies are single dense round DNA remnants.

64052.recognize_zh: 中央巨噬細胞的藍色胞質裡包著一顆腎形核的後骨髓球（metamyelocyte，外圍有吞噬空泡），旁邊還有數個小紫色顆粒狀的血小板，屬於噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Macrophage with abundant blue-grey vacuolated cytoplasm and an irregular outline
Engulfed myeloid cell with an indented (kidney-shaped) nucleus inside a clear phagocytic vacuole, consistent with a metamyelocyte
Macrophage nucleus oval and eccentric, partly overlapped by the engulfed cell
Several small dense purple bodies in the cytoplasm consistent with phagocytosed platelets
Background aspirate with red cells, platelet clumps and a neutrophil at lower left
64052.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Romanowsky stain, high power) shows a macrophage with abundant vacuolated blue-grey cytoplasm containing an intact myeloid cell with an indented nucleus, consistent with a metamyelocyte, within a clear phagocytic vacuole. Multiple small dense purple bodies consistent with engulfed platelets are also present in the cytoplasm. Neighbouring red cells, platelets and a band neutrophil are unremarkable. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis of a granulocytic precursor and platelets, supportive of hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis shows a viable cell passing within the cytoplasm of a megakaryocyte or Rosai-Dorfman histiocyte without a digestive vacuole, whereas hemophagocytosis shows engulfed cells in vacuoles, often with degeneration.
A cell merely lying on top of a macrophage lacks a surrounding clear phagocytic vacuole and shows a focal plane different from the macrophage cytoplasm.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear fragments rather than intact identifiable hematopoietic cells and platelets.

63988.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被大量緊密排列（back-to-back）、大小相近的濾泡取代，套區變薄；高倍濾泡內以小至中型、核有切跡的中心細胞（centrocytes）為主，少見大型中心母細胞，且濾泡 CD10、Bcl-6 陽性並 Bcl-2 陽性、Ki-67 低，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Effaced nodal architecture by numerous crowded back-to-back follicles of similar size with attenuated mantle zones
Follicles composed predominantly of small to medium centrocytes with irregular, angulated/cleaved nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli (gray arrow)
Rare large centroblasts with round vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli (black arrow)
Lack of polarization and absence of tingible-body macrophages
IHC: CD10 and Bcl-6 positive; Bcl-2 aberrantly positive within follicles; low Ki-67 without zonation
63988.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show effacement of the normal architecture by a proliferation of crowded, back-to-back neoplastic follicles with attenuated mantle zones, extending throughout the node. At high power, the follicles are composed predominantly of small to medium-sized centrocytes with irregular, cleaved nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli, with only rare large centroblasts; polarization and tingible-body macrophages are absent. The neoplastic cells are positive for CD10 and Bcl-6 and show aberrant Bcl-2 expression within the follicles, and the Ki-67 proliferation index is low. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, low grade (grade 1-2).

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show polarization, well-formed mantles, numerous tingible-body macrophages, Bcl-2-negative germinal centers, and high polarized Ki-67.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Marginal zone cells are CD10/Bcl-6 negative with monocytoid pale cytoplasm, and colonized follicles show residual CD21 meshworks with disrupted germinal centers.
Mantle cell lymphoma lacks centroblasts, is CD5+ and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive, and CD10/Bcl-6 negative.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma, grade 3 / large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Grade 3 shows more than 15 centroblasts per high-power field or solid sheets of centroblasts with high Ki-67, unlike the rare centroblasts here.

63988.stain: H&E; IHC: CD10, Bcl-6, Bcl-2, Ki-67

63924.recognize_zh: A–C 箭頭所指的是大型漿母細胞（plasmablast）：核大、染色質細緻、核仁明顯、細胞質深藍且 hof 不明顯；D 為成熟但異常的漿細胞，E 為雙核漿細胞，F 為含 Russell bodies 的 Mott cell，同一骨髓中成熟與不成熟漿細胞並存。
features: Panels A–C: large plasmablasts with large round nucleus, fine dispersed chromatin and visible nucleolus; moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with faint or absent perinuclear hof
Plasmablast cytoplasm irregular with blunt cytoplasmic projections (A, B)
Panel D: clusters of more mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and pale perinuclear hof
Panel E: binucleated plasma cell with abundant blue cytoplasm
Panel F: Mott cell with cytoplasm packed by pale blue Russell bodies
Background marrow with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
63924.describe_en: Composite bone marrow aspirate smears show an infiltrate of abnormal plasma cells spanning a spectrum of maturation. Panels A–C show large plasmablasts with a high N:C ratio, large nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and a prominent nucleolus, and basophilic cytoplasm lacking a well-formed perinuclear hof. Panel D shows mature-appearing but aberrant plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and hofs, panel E a binucleated plasma cell, and panel F a Mott cell with multiple Russell bodies. The number of plasmablasts should be quantified (≥2% of marrow cells defines the plasmablastic morphologic subtype). Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; plasmablastic lymphoma favors extramedullary/nodal disease, HIV and EBER positivity and MYC rearrangement, whereas plasmablastic myeloma shows marrow disease with CRAB features, M-protein and more frequent CD56 expression.
Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods and express MPO/CD34/CD117, while plasmablasts show abundant basophilic cytoplasm, CD38/CD138 bright and cytoplasmic light chain restriction.
Reactive states show polytypic, predominantly mature plasma cells without binucleation clusters or a clonal light-chain population.
Immunoblasts express CD20/PAX5 and surface immunoglobulin, whereas plasmablasts are CD20-negative, PAX5-negative and CD138-positive.

63796.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖而非形態照片：粉紅色族群為 CD117 強陽性、CD33 陽性、側散射（SSC）偏高的肥大細胞，且同時表現 CD2 與 CD25，這種異常共表現就是系統性肥大細胞增生症（SM）的非典型肥大細胞。
features: Four-panel flow cytometry dot plots gated on mast cells (magenta population)
CD117 bright / CD33 positive population distinct from CD117-negative myeloid (green) and lymphoid (blue) events
Mast cells show moderate CD45 with intermediate-high side scatter
Aberrant co-expression of CD2 and CD25 on the CD117-bright population
Small event count consistent with a minor population in a post-therapy marrow
63796.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of a post-induction bone marrow aspirate identifies a discrete population of mast cells defined by bright CD117 and CD33 expression, moderate CD45 and relatively high side scatter. This population aberrantly co-expresses CD25 and CD2, a phenotype that fulfils a minor WHO criterion for systemic mastocytosis. No morphology can be assessed from this figure; correlation with the aspirate (spindled atypical mast cell aggregates), tryptase and KIT D816 status is required. In the setting of treated t(8;21) AML with KIT D816H, the findings support systemic mastocytosis with an associated myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are CD117 bright but lack aberrant CD25 and CD2 expression.
Myeloblasts are CD117 dim-moderate with low side scatter and CD34/HLA-DR expression, not CD117 bright with high SSC and CD25.
Basophils are CD123 bright/HLA-DR negative and CD117 negative, unlike this CD117-bright population.

63732.recognize_zh: 箭頭處是一條細長的巨核細胞胞質帶，內含粉紫色細顆粒，兩端與邊緣有一顆顆芽生、脫落中的血小板，長度遠超過數個紅血球而且沒有細胞核，這就是周邊血中的前血小板（proplatelet）／巨核細胞胞質碎片。
features: Elongated anucleate cytoplasmic ribbon spanning several red cell diameters (arrow)
Finely granular lilac cytoplasm resembling platelet cytoplasm
Platelet-sized buds and detached granular platelets along the margins and at one bulbous end
No nucleus within the structure
Adjacent small lymphocyte and a cell with purple cytoplasm; background red cells normocytic
63732.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an elongated anucleate cytoplasmic structure, several red cells in length, with finely granular lilac cytoplasm and numerous platelet-sized buds budding from its margins and one end (arrow). The morphology is consistent with a circulating proplatelet (megakaryocyte cytoplasmic fragment) shedding platelets. Adjacent leukocytes and the background red cells show no specific abnormality in this field. Circulating megakaryocyte fragments and proplatelets can be seen in myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms (especially myelofibrosis) and marrow stress, and may be miscounted as leukocytes by automated analyzers.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps are aggregates of discrete platelets without a continuous cytoplasmic ribbon.
Microfilariae are much longer with a sheath or cuticle and a column of discrete nuclei, whereas this is anucleate granular cytoplasm.
Micromegakaryocytes and bare nuclei contain a dense lobulated or round nucleus, which is absent here.
Smudge cells show disrupted pink nuclear chromatin and fibrin strands lack granular platelet-like cytoplasm with budding platelets.

63668.recognize_zh: 視野中央是一顆小型成熟淋巴球，大小與紅血球相近，核圓、染色質緻密成塊，只有一圈窄窄的淡藍色無顆粒細胞質；背景紅血球多皺縮成棘狀。
features: Small cell about 1 to 1.5 red cell diameters
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no visible nucleolus
Background red cells diffusely crenated (echinocytes), consistent with preparation artifact
Rare red cell with a small refractile artifact
63668.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte with a round nucleus, condensed clumped chromatin, no visible nucleolus, and a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm. The cell measures approximately 1 to 1.5 red cell diameters. Background red cells show diffuse crenation, most consistent with a preparation artifact. Findings are consistent with a normal small lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are similar in size but show coarse block-like 'soccer-ball' chromatin with smudge cells and absolute lymphocytosis.
A late erythroblast has a smaller, pyknotic nucleus and pink-orange hemoglobinized cytoplasm.
Lymphoblasts are larger with finely dispersed chromatin and may show nucleoli.
LGLs have more abundant cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules.

63604.recognize_zh: 大型巨核細胞的多葉核旁邊，箭頭指處細胞質內有一顆完整的小型分葉核細胞，外圍有一圈透明空隙（clear halo），代表另一顆白血球完整地位於巨核細胞質內，即細胞穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a lobulated, hyperchromatic nucleus and abundant pale granular cytoplasm
Intact small cell with a lobulated nucleus within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm (arrow), consistent with a neutrophil
Clear halo/vacuole surrounding the engulfed cell, indicating it lies within a membrane-bound space
Engulfed cell retains nuclear integrity without degradation, distinguishing it from phagocytosis
Background of numerous red cells, a lymphocyte and an erythroid precursor
63604.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. An intact small leukocyte with a lobulated nucleus, most likely a neutrophil, lies within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm surrounded by a clear halo (arrow), without evidence of degradation. Findings are consistent with emperipolesis of a neutrophil within a megakaryocyte, which can be seen in normal marrow and is increased in myeloproliferative neoplasms (particularly myelofibrosis) and reactive states.

ddx.vs: Phagocytosed cells lie within a histiocyte with a bland oval nucleus and show degeneration, whereas emperipolesis involves an intact cell inside a megakaryocyte.

ddx.dx: Overlapping cell on top of a megakaryocyte
ddx.vs: An overlying cell is in a different focal plane and lacks the surrounding clear halo within the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Separated nuclear lobe of the megakaryocyte
ddx.vs: A detached megakaryocyte lobe has the same dense chromatin as the parent nucleus and lacks its own cytoplasm and halo.

63540.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數顆胞質呈天藍色、顆粒狀且邊界不規則的組織球，核小而偏心，這種藍綠色胞質就是海藍組織球（sea-blue histiocyte），是細胞轉換增加時脂質堆積的表現。
features: At least three histiocytes with abundant sky-blue to blue-green, finely granular cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Small eccentric round to oval nuclei within the sea-blue histiocytes
Surrounding hematopoietic cells include immature myeloid cells with fine chromatin, lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
Smudged/streaked nuclear material (crushed cells) in the particle
Blood-rich background with fat vacuoles and scattered platelets
63540.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several histiocytes with abundant granular sky-blue to blue-green cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, consistent with sea-blue histiocytes, among a mixed population of myeloid precursors, lymphocytes and erythroid cells with admixed fat vacuoles and smudged nuclear material. The background cells include immature forms, but blast enumeration requires a formal differential count. Sea-blue histiocytes represent accumulation of ceroid/phospholipid from increased cell turnover and are nonspecific. In the clinical context of prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are consistent with secondary sea-blue histiocytosis associated with a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have pale grey-blue cytoplasm with a wrinkled tissue paper or crumpled silk texture rather than blue-green granules.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML or myeloma
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells mimic Gaucher cells with fibrillary cytoplasm, whereas sea-blue histiocytes have coarse blue granules; both are secondary to high turnover.
Niemann-Pick cells show foamy, vacuolated, pale cytoplasm with lipid droplets, although sea-blue histiocytes may coexist in type B disease.
Hemosiderin appears as coarse blue-black or golden-brown granules that are Prussian blue positive, whereas sea-blue pigment is diffuse blue-green on Romanowsky stain.

63476.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一團緊密聚集的母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍、周邊有大量泡狀突起與脫落的細胞質碎片（pseudoblebs），像在生出血小板，這種成簇加上冒泡的外觀是巨核母細胞的線索。
features: Cohesive cluster of medium-sized blasts, mimicking a metastatic tumor clump
Round nuclei with fine to slightly condensed chromatin and high N:C ratio
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous peripheral blebs and detached cytoplasmic fragments
Scattered single blasts with similar morphology outside the cluster
Background red cells in a thick area; a granular cell/platelet aggregate at upper right
63476.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of medium-sized blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, high N:C ratios, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing abundant peripheral blebs and detached cytoplasmic fragments. Similar single blasts are scattered nearby. Cytoplasmic granules and Auer rods are not seen. The clustering and pseudobleb formation are characteristic of megakaryoblasts, and in a patient with CML and blasts showing CD61 expression, findings are consistent with megakaryoblastic blast crisis; marrow fibrosis often accompanies this and can cause a dry tap.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor clusters show nuclear molding, rosettes, or cytoplasmic vacuoles and express synaptophysin, myogenin, or keratins rather than CD41/CD61.
Myeloblasts are usually dispersed rather than cohesive and are MPO positive with granules or Auer rods.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and express CD20/CD10 with MYC rearrangement, rather than blebs.
Normal megakaryocytes are much larger with multilobated nuclei and granular cytoplasm, unlike these small uninucleate blasts.

63348.recognize_zh: 單一中型淋巴樣細胞，淡藍灰色細胞質周圍一圈細長毛髮狀突起，核為圓形偏卵圓、染色質較疏鬆，看不到明顯核仁，這是毛狀細胞（hairy cell）的典型外觀。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, larger than a mature small lymphocyte, with moderate N:C ratio
Abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with circumferential fine, irregular hair-like projections
Round to slightly oval centrally placed nucleus
Finely dispersed, somewhat open chromatin without a visible nucleolus
No cytoplasmic granules; background red cells show overlap in a thick area of the smear
63348.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm bearing circumferential fine, hair-like cytoplasmic projections. The nucleus is round to oval with relatively open chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable apart from overlap in a thick area. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell; a prominent nucleolus, which would be expected in hairy cell leukemia variant, is not seen, so flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing are needed to classify the process.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have hairy projections but show a distinct central nucleolus and more condensed chromatin, and are CD25-, annexin A1- and BRAF V600E-negative.
SMZL villous lymphocytes are smaller with more condensed chromatin and short polar (bipolar) villi rather than circumferential fine projections.
Monocytes are larger with folded or reniform nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and vacuoles, without circumferential hair-like projections.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells with basophilic scalloped edges rather than fine circumferential filamentous projections.

63284.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中有許多染色質細緻、核質比高的芽細胞，兩個箭頭所指為胞質豐富淡藍、內含細顆粒且只有單一圓核的小型巨核細胞（mononuclear micromegakaryocyte），屬於巨核細胞異生，支持 AML 伴骨髓發育不良相關變化。
features: Numerous medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, finely granular to dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Large cell (green arrow) with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and a single small round nucleus, consistent with a mononuclear megakaryocyte
Second cell (white arrow) with pale blue granular cytoplasm at the lower left, similar in appearance
Granulocytic cell with coarse dark granules at the top (likely eosinophil/basophil lineage precursor)
Fine linear streaks over one blast of uncertain significance (possible Auer rods versus artifact); fat vacuoles in the particle-rich area
63284.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (high power) shows numerous blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The arrows highlight cells with abundant pale blue, finely granular cytoplasm and a single small round nucleus, consistent with dysplastic mononuclear megakaryocytes. A granulated precursor with coarse dark granules is present at the top of the field, and fine linear streaks overlying one blast are of uncertain significance at this resolution. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with megakaryocytic dysplasia, in keeping with myelodysplasia-related changes; blast enumeration on a 500-cell differential and cytogenetic studies are required.

ddx.vs: In AMKL the predominant blasts show cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 positivity, rather than myeloblasts with scattered mature-cytoplasm mononuclear megakaryocytes.
Morphology of dysplasia is shared; MDS-IB is distinguished by a blast count below the AML threshold on the aspirate differential.
Histiocytes have vacuolated, often phagocytic cytoplasm with an oval or reniform nucleus rather than finely granular megakaryocytic cytoplasm.
inv(16) AML shows eosinophil precursors with large purple-violet granules and monocytic differentiation with CBFB::MYH11, requiring cytogenetics to exclude.

63028.recognize_zh: 周邊血可見大量中至大型異常淋巴細胞，核不規則、染色質較細、胞質嗜鹼性且有突起，外觀很像淋巴母細胞；但流式顯示表面 CD3+、CD4+CD8−、CD45RA+/CD197+，而 cyTdT 陰性，排除前驅 T 淋巴母細胞，加上複雜核型與組織瀰漫浸潤，支持周邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤（PTCL, NOS）。
features: Medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angular nuclear outlines and moderately fine chromatin (A, B)
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs/projections; blast-like appearance
Multicolor karyotype (SKY/M-FISH) showing a complex karyotype with multiple structural abnormalities and a marker chromosome (C)
Flow cytometry: CD45 bright, surface CD3+, CD4+ CD8-, CD2+, CD7 partially dim, CD45RA+ CD197 (CCR7)+, cytoplasmic TdT and TCL1 negative (D)
Tissue H&E with diffuse infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells; IHC showing membranous positivity (F) and a high nuclear-staining fraction (G)
63028.describe_en: Composite figure. Peripheral blood smear shows marked lymphocytosis composed of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, angular nuclei, moderately fine chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, mimicking lymphoblasts (A, B). Multicolor karyotyping demonstrates a complex karyotype (C). Flow cytometry identifies a mature T-cell population that is surface CD3+, CD4+, CD8-, CD2+, with partial CD7 and a CD45RA+/CCR7+ phenotype, and is negative for cytoplasmic TdT and TCL1 (D), excluding T-lymphoblastic and T-prolymphocytic leukemia. A tissue biopsy shows a diffuse atypical lymphoid infiltrate with membranous and high-fraction nuclear immunostaining (E-G; specific markers not labeled). Findings are consistent with peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, in leukemic phase.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts are TdT-positive and usually CD34/CD1a-positive with only cytoplasmic CD3, whereas these cells are TdT-negative with surface CD3.
T-PLL cells are smaller with a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, and typically express TCL1 with inv(14)/t(14;14), whereas this population is TCL1-negative.
ATLL shows flower cells with condensed chromatin, CD25 bright, CD7 loss and HTLV-1 positivity.
Sézary cells are smaller with cerebriform nuclei, CD7 and CD26 loss, and associated erythroderma, rather than blast-like cells with basophilic cytoplasm.

63028.stain: Wright-Giemsa; flow cytometry; SKY karyotype; H&E; IHC

62964.recognize_zh: PET 見頸部高代謝腫塊（箭頭），切片為成片大型、核不規則且核仁明顯的腫瘤細胞；CD30 呈強烈均一的膜/高基氏體染色，ALK 陰性，FISH 在兩組分離探針中都見到紅綠訊號分離（箭頭），代表同時有 DUSP22 與 TP63 重組的 ALK 陰性 ALCL。
features: PET-CT (A): FDG-avid bulky cervical mass (arrow)
H&E (B, inset): diffuse sheets of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular (some kidney-shaped) nuclei, prominent nucleoli and ample cytoplasm
IHC (C): strong, uniform membranous and Golgi-type CD30 staining in virtually all tumor cells
IHC (D): diffuse nuclear positivity in tumor cells (nuclear marker, unlabeled)
IHC (E): negative stain in tumor cells (consistent with ALK negativity)
FISH (F, G): break-apart probes showing separated red and green signals (arrows) in tumor nuclei, indicating two distinct rearrangements
62964.describe_en: Composite figure. PET-CT shows an FDG-avid cervical nodal mass. Biopsy shows diffuse sheets of large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm. The tumor cells show strong, uniform CD30 staining in a membranous and Golgi pattern, diffuse nuclear staining with a second marker, and no staining with a third marker. Break-apart FISH shows split signals with two separate probes. Findings are consistent with ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma harboring concurrent DUSP22 and TP63 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: ALK-positive ALCL shows nuclear/cytoplasmic ALK staining from ALK rearrangement, which is negative here.
cHL has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background with CD15+ and weak PAX5, not uniform sheets of CD30+ cells.
PTCL-NOS shows heterogeneous rather than strong uniform CD30 and lacks the hallmark cells and DUSP22/TP63 rearrangements.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive and CD30/T-cell-marker-negative.

62964.stain: PET-CT; H&E; IHC: CD30 and others; FISH

62900.recognize_zh: 左側為一個大型淋巴球，細胞質淡藍而豐富，一側聚集一群粗大的嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），核染色質中度凝集；右側為對照用的嗜中性球。細胞質豐富且顆粒聚集成簇，是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）的變異型態。
features: Large lymphocyte with moderately abundant pale blue cytoplasm
Coarse azurophilic granules aggregated in a cluster at one pole of the cytoplasm
Irregular to slightly indented nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and faint pale areas
Adjacent band-to-segmented neutrophil with fine granules for size comparison
Background red cells normochromic with scattered platelets
62900.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with moderately abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing a cluster of coarse azurophilic granules aggregated at one pole, and a slightly irregular nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin. A neutrophil lies adjacent for comparison, and the background red cells and platelets are unremarkable in this field. No blasts or atypical nuclear features are seen. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte showing aggregated cytoplasmic granules, in this clinical setting most likely reactive; persistent LGL lymphocytosis would require flow cytometry and TCR clonality studies to exclude T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; distinguished by persistent LGL count >2 x10^9/L, aberrant CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ phenotype, and clonal TCR rearrangement or STAT3 mutation.
Myeloid precursors have finer chromatin, a Golgi zone, and granules distributed throughout the cytoplasm rather than a lymphoid nucleus with a polar granule cluster.
Contains one or few giant inclusions, with giant granules also in neutrophils.
Has deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells and usually lacks prominent azurophilic granules.

62836.recognize_zh: 高倍下骨小樑邊緣呈扇形凹陷，凹陷內排列多顆多核蝕骨細胞；左側骨髓腔被含紡錘狀纖維母細胞的疏鬆纖維組織取代並延伸到吸收面，形成旁小樑纖維化，符合副甲狀腺亢進的纖維性骨炎（osteitis fibrosa）。
features: Bony trabeculae with deeply scalloped resorption front
Several multinucleated osteoclasts with eosinophilic cytoplasm seated in Howship's lacunae along the scalloped edge
Resorption bay filled with pale, finely fibrillary stroma
Adjacent marrow space replaced by loose fibrous tissue with spindle-to-oval fibroblast nuclei and small vessels (paratrabecular fibrosis)
Scattered fat vacuoles; few hematopoietic cells in the fibrotic area
62836.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section (photographed through the eyepiece) shows bony trabeculae with a deeply scalloped resorption surface lined by several multinucleated osteoclasts within Howship's lacunae. The adjacent marrow space is replaced by loose fibrous tissue containing spindle-shaped fibroblasts and small vessels, extending into the resorption bay as paratrabecular fibrosis, with only scattered hematopoietic cells. No neoplastic infiltrate is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with osteitis fibrosa of renal osteodystrophy due to secondary hyperparathyroidism.

ddx.vs: Morphology is the same; biochemical and renal status distinguish primary from secondary hyperparathyroidism.
PMF shows diffuse reticulin/collagen fibrosis with atypical megakaryocyte clusters and new bone formation rather than osteoclast-lined resorption bays.
Desmoplastic metastases contain cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells in the fibrous stroma, which is absent in this bland fibroblastic tissue.
A prior biopsy site shows granulation tissue, woven new bone and hemosiderin rather than widespread osteoclastic tunnelling.

62772.recognize_zh: 抹片中央有一條捲曲、類似微絲蟲的長形結構，但內部沒有排列成柱的體核、也看不出頭尾；背景許多紅血球上散布細小黑點且位於不同焦平面，較符合真菌孢子等外來污染物，而非真正的寄生蟲。
features: Single coiled, elongated, sheath-like structure about 3-4 red cells across, with a hollow central lumen
Irregular speckled dark purple staining along the coil without a column of somatic nuclei
No identifiable cephalic space or tapered tail as seen in microfilariae
Numerous tiny dark dot-like particles overlying red cells and background, suggestive of contaminating spores
Red cells with rouleaux-like stacking; no intraerythrocytic ring forms or gametocytes
62772.describe_en: Smear shows red cells with some rouleaux-like stacking and scattered platelets. A single coiled, elongated structure with a hollow center and irregular speckled purple staining is present; it lacks the orderly column of nuclei, cephalic space, and tapered tail expected of a microfilaria. Numerous small dark punctate particles are distributed over the red cells and background, apparently in a different plane of focus, favoring extraneous material rather than true intracellular inclusions. Findings are most consistent with fungal contamination of the preparation mimicking a parasite; review of a freshly collected and stained specimen is recommended before reporting a parasitic infection.

ddx.vs: True microfilariae are much longer, contain a continuous column of discrete somatic nuclei with species-specific tail nuclei, and may show a sheath, features absent in this structure.
True red cell inclusions lie within the cell in the same focal plane and are confined to a subset of erythrocytes, not also scattered in the background.
Stain precipitate forms irregular crystalline or granular deposits of variable size without the uniform round shape of spores, and it does not form an organized coiled body.
Borrelia are thin, loosely coiled extracellular spirochetes of fine uniform width, rather than a single thick coiled sheath-like body.

62708.recognize_zh: 這張血液抹片看不到母細胞（blasts）：大多數紅血球內有均勻的細小藍點，中央一個多角形、無明顯細胞核的粉紅色大構造，邊緣聚集深藍色顆粒。這些發現不能用來診斷 MPAL，需搭配流式細胞儀。
features: No blasts or other nucleated leukocytes in this field
Numerous RBCs contain fine, evenly distributed punctate blue dots (basophilic stippling versus stain precipitate)
Large polygonal pink anucleate structure (~3 RBC diameters) with clumped dark blue granules at its periphery; nature indeterminate (possible artifact or smudged/degenerated cell)
Some crenated RBCs (echinocyte-like, likely drying artifact)
No platelet clumps or schistocytes in view
62708.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear field shows red cells, many of which contain fine punctate basophilic dots that may represent basophilic stippling or stain precipitate, together with scattered crenated forms. A large polygonal eosinophilic anucleate structure with peripheral clusters of coarse blue granules is present; its identity cannot be established at this resolution and it may be artifactual or a degenerated cell. No blasts are identified in this field. The image does not by itself demonstrate the features of mixed phenotype acute leukemia; the diagnosis rests on blast enumeration and flow cytometric lineage assignment (MPO plus strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10).

ddx.vs: True stippling shows variably sized RBC granules in a subset of cells, whereas uniform dots in nearly every RBC and on the background favor stain precipitate.
Pappenheimer bodies are few, clustered at the RBC periphery and Prussian blue positive, unlike diffuse fine dots in most cells.
A basophil or mast cell would show a recognizable nucleus with metachromatic granules throughout the cytoplasm rather than an anucleate pink plate with peripheral granule clumps.

62644.recognize_zh: 這是紅血球 PNH 分析的門控圖：在對數刻度的前向散射（FS）對側向散射（SS）圖上，框出主要的紅血球族群（B gate），並排除左下方低散射的碎片與血小板，之後再以 CD59 分出第 I、II、III 型紅血球。
features: Log-scale forward scatter (x) versus side scatter (y) plot gated on singlets
Dense elongated red cell population enclosed by gate B at FS ~10^1.5-10^2
Low-scatter debris/platelet events excluded at lower left
Sparse high-FS/SS events at upper right outside the gate (doublets or leukocytes)
No antigen expression shown; gating step only
62644.describe_en: Flow cytometry dot plot of log forward scatter versus log side scatter, gated on singlets, shows a dense, elongated red blood cell population enclosed by gate B, with low-scatter debris and platelet events excluded at the lower left and sparse larger events outside the gate. This is a gating step in red cell PNH analysis and does not by itself demonstrate a PNH clone; the gated red cells are subsequently analyzed for CD59 expression to quantify type I, II and III cells.

62580.recognize_zh: 這是頸部下段／胸廓入口的軸切 CT，箭頭指向右側頸動脈鞘外側的軟組織密度結節，符合腫大淋巴結；影像只能指出病灶位置與大小，無法做淋巴瘤分型或分級。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT at the level of the thoracic inlet/lower neck
Arrow marks a rounded soft-tissue-density nodule in the right lower cervical region lateral to the enhancing great vessels
Homogeneous attenuation without evident necrosis or calcification
Trachea midline; clavicles and vertebral body are in the plane of section
62580.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT image through the lower neck at the level of the clavicles shows a rounded, homogeneous soft-tissue-density nodule in the right lower cervical region (arrow), lateral to the enhancing carotid and jugular vessels, consistent with an enlarged lymph node. There is no visible central necrosis or calcification, and the trachea remains midline. Imaging documents the site of nodal disease but cannot establish histologic type or grade, which require tissue biopsy.

62516.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下可見多個淡粉紅、形狀不規則（地圖狀／星狀）的壞死區，周圍有呈柵欄狀排列（palisading）的上皮樣組織球帶，此為化膿性壞死性肉芽腫，符合貓抓病。
features: Multiple irregular, geographic to stellate pale eosinophilic necrotic zones
Rim of elongated epithelioid histiocytes arranged in a palisading pattern around necrosis
Granular necrotic debris within centers without well-formed caseation
Intervening lymphocyte-rich zones between granulomatous areas
No multinucleated giant cells or organisms identifiable at this magnification
62516.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows extensive granulomatous inflammation with multiple irregular, geographic to stellate zones of necrosis. The necrotic foci are rimmed by palisading epithelioid histiocytes, with lymphocyte-rich tissue between them. Organisms cannot be assessed on H&E at this magnification; a Warthin-Starry stain, Bartonella serology, or PCR would be needed for confirmation. Findings are consistent with necrotizing (suppurative) granulomatous lymphadenitis, compatible with cat scratch disease in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Mycobacterial granulomas show caseous necrosis with Langhans giant cells rather than stellate neutrophil-rich microabscesses, and AFB stain or culture is positive.
These produce morphologically identical stellate suppurative granulomas, so distinction relies on node site (inguinal), serology, or PCR rather than histology.
Kikuchi shows paracortical karyorrhectic necrosis with crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells but lacks neutrophils and palisading epithelioid granulomas.
Fungal infection can cause necrotizing granulomas, but GMS/PAS stains reveal yeast or hyphae.

62452.recognize_zh: 這是同一中期分裂相的反轉 DAPI 影像（染色體呈灰黑色類似 G 帶，方便辨認染色體）：der(9) 與 Ph 各有一個融合訊號，正常 9 號為紅、22 號為綠（2F1R1G），7 號與 dic(7;12) 皆有完整的 7q 探針訊號，12 號與 dic(7;12) 各有一個 CEP12 紅訊號。
features: Reverse (inverted) DAPI metaphase image rendering chromosomes grey-black with G-like banding for chromosome identification
BCR/ABL1 dual-fusion probe: red ABL1 signal on normal chromosome 9, green BCR signal on normal chromosome 22
Red-green fusion signals on der(9) and the Philadelphia chromosome (2F1R1G pattern)
CEP12 red signals on normal chromosome 12 and the dic(7;12)
Aqua, red and green del(7q) probe signals present on both normal chromosome 7 and dic(7;12), indicating no 7q deletion
Non-morphologic cytogenetic image
62452.describe_en: Reverse DAPI image of a metaphase hybridized with a BCR/ABL1 dual-color dual-fusion probe, a chromosome 12 centromere enumeration probe, and a triple-color 7q deletion probe; inversion of the DAPI counterstain produces G-like banding that allows each signal to be assigned to a specific chromosome. The BCR/ABL1 probe shows a 2F1R1G pattern with fusion signals on der(9) and the Philadelphia chromosome. CEP12 signals localize to the normal chromosome 12 and the dic(7;12), and the 7q probe signal set is present on both the normal chromosome 7 and the dic(7;12). These findings confirm t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with BCR::ABL1 fusion and localize chromosome 7 and 12 material to the dic(7;12) without 7q loss.

ddx.vs: Deletions adjacent to the der(9) breakpoint remove one fusion signal, whereas two fusion signals are present here.
These would show only one set of 7q probe signals, whereas two complete sets are present.
Chance colocalization in interphase can mimic fusion, whereas metaphase localization here assigns the fusion signals to der(9) and Ph.

62324.recognize_zh: 九格合成圖：淋巴結中在 CD5 陽性的 CLL 背景（D）裡出現大細胞結節與竇內浸潤（A、C），大細胞核仁明顯、細胞質豐富（B），且 CD20 陰性（E）、EMA（F）與 MUM1（G）陽性、EBER（H）與 HHV8（I）核陽性，符合 CLL 背景下的淋巴結外腔型原發性滲出液淋巴瘤。
features: A: low-power lymph node with pale nodules of large cells within a sea of small lymphocytes
B: large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, some immunoblastic/plasmablastic
C: large atypical cells within a subcapsular/peripheral sinus
D-E: CD5 highlights the small-cell CLL background with negative nodules; CD20 stains small background B cells but not the large cells
F-G: EMA and MUM1 strongly positive in the large cells, including the sinusoidal component
H-I: EBER in situ hybridization and HHV8 (LANA) show nuclear positivity in the large cells
62324.describe_en: This composite of a cervical lymph node shows two distinct populations. At low and high power (A-B), nodules of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic nucleoli are embedded in a background of small lymphocytes, and large cells also fill a peripheral sinus (C). Immunostains show that the small background cells are CD5-positive (D) and CD20-positive, whereas the large cells lack CD20 (E) and express EMA (F) and MUM1 (G), with nuclear positivity for EBER (H) and HHV8/LANA (I). The findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with transformation to an HHV8- and EBV-positive large cell lymphoma with the phenotype of extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Richter transformation to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Conventional Richter DLBCL retains CD20/PAX5 expression and is HHV8-negative, unlike the CD20-negative, HHV8-positive large cells here.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares CD20 negativity, MUM1 and EBER positivity but is HHV8/LANA-negative, making HHV8 staining the key discriminator.
ALCL is CD30- and EMA-positive with sinusoidal spread but shows T-cell/cytotoxic markers or ALK and is negative for HHV8 and EBER.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: HHV8-positive DLBCL arises in the setting of multicentric Castleman disease and is typically EBER-negative with cytoplasmic IgM lambda, whereas PEL is usually EBER-positive and immunoglobulin-negative.

62324.stain: H&E; IHC: CD5, CD20, EMA, MUM1, HHV8; ISH: EBER

62132.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見數個大小不一的血小板聚集團塊（platelet clumps），單顆散在血小板很少，紅血球與嗜中性球形態正常，提示 EDTA 引起的假性血小板減少（pseudothrombocytopenia）。
features: Multiple platelet aggregates of variable size scattered across the field
Individual platelets within clumps show normal granularity and size
Very few single free platelets outside the clumps
Normocytic normochromic red cells without schistocytes
Morphologically normal segmented neutrophil
62132.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several platelet aggregates of variable size distributed through the field, with few single platelets between them. The platelets within the aggregates are of normal size and granularity. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without fragments, and the neutrophil present is unremarkable. In a patient with a low automated platelet count and no bleeding, the findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia, which should be confirmed by repeating the count in a citrate-anticoagulated sample.

ddx.vs: ITP shows genuinely reduced single platelets, often with large forms, and lacks platelet clumps, with no correction in citrate.
Satellitism is another EDTA artifact in which platelets rosette around neutrophils rather than forming free-floating aggregates.
Clotted samples show fibrin strands with platelet clumps in any anticoagulant and usually a visible clot, whereas EDTA pseudothrombocytopenia corrects in citrate.
Macrothrombocytopenias are undercounted because individual giant platelets approach red cell size, not because platelets aggregate.

62068.recognize_zh: 視野中可見多個比其他紅血球小、顏色較深且沒有中央淡染區（central pallor）的圓形紅血球，即球形紅血球（spherocytes）；同時有明顯大小不一與鋸齒狀的皺縮紅血球。
features: Marked anisocytosis with admixed large and small red cells
Numerous small, dense, round red cells lacking central pallor (spherocytes/microspherocytes)
Many crenated cells with regular short projections (echinocytes), likely drying/storage artifact
Central pallor is poorly seen in most cells, suggesting a thick or slowly dried area of the smear
Small red cell fragments/debris and fine precipitate in the background
62068.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with a population of small, densely staining round red cells that lack central pallor, consistent with spherocytes. Numerous crenated red cells with evenly spaced short projections are also present and are most likely a preparation artifact rather than true pathology. Central pallor is poorly preserved in many cells and some stain precipitate is present, which limits confident enumeration of spherocytes; assessment should be made in a thin, well-spread area. No leukocytes or platelets are evaluable in this field. Findings are consistent with a spherocytic hemolytic process; hereditary spherocytosis versus immune hemolysis should be distinguished with DAT, family history, and EMA-binding flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar (spherocytes with polychromasia), so a positive DAT for IgG with or without C3 is required to separate it from hereditary spherocytosis.
Echinocytes carry 10-30 regular short spicules and retain normal size, whereas spherocytes are smooth, smaller and uniformly dense.
In thick areas all cells lose central pallor and overlap, while true spherocytes are smaller and denser than neighboring cells in the thin monolayer.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet and triangular fragments) and thrombocytopenia, rather than a predominance of intact round spherocytes.

62004.recognize_zh: 與同病例另一張染色相比，此圖只有部分細胞呈深藍色細胞質訊號，多數細胞只有淡紅色核對比染色；配對的輕鏈原位雜交中，一邊一致陽性、另一邊僅少數陽性，即代表輕鏈限制（light-chain restriction），但探針未標示。
features: Cellular marrow section with pink nuclear counterstain
Subset of cells with dark blue cytoplasmic granular signal, often perinuclear
Majority of cells negative for the signal
Positive cells scattered and in small groups rather than diffuse sheets
Probe/antigen not labeled; morphology limited by the preparation
62004.describe_en: Section of bone marrow stained with a chromogenic in situ hybridization or immunostain (dark blue chromogen, pink counterstain; probe not labeled) shows positive cytoplasmic signal in a subset of cells, while most cells in the field are negative. The positive cells are scattered and in small groups.
