When compared with the companion stain showing diffuse positivity, this pattern is consistent with the non-restricted light chain in a light-chain-restricted plasma cell neoplasm; the image does not demonstrate cyclin D1 itself, and probe identity should be verified in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates show comparable numbers of kappa and lambda cells in a normal ratio rather than a marked imbalance between paired stains.
MCL lacks cytoplasmic light chain mRNA-rich plasma cells and is CD20+/CD5+/SOX11+ rather than CD138+.
True signal localizes to cytoplasm of individual plasma cells, whereas background artifact is extracellular and not cell-associated.

61940.recognize_zh: 高倍IgD染色可見左下方一條帶狀排列的IgD膜狀陽性小淋巴球（外套區細胞），右上方則是IgD陰性、核較大的生發中心細胞，另有兩個強陽性的細胞，顯示外套細胞與生發中心的交界與互相穿插。
features: Band of small lymphocytes with membranous IgD staining streaming diagonally across the lower left
Adjacent area of larger IgD-negative germinal center cells with vesicular nuclei
Two isolated strongly positive cells with intense cytoplasmic staining (likely IgD-expressing plasma cells)
Faint background staining in the germinal center area
Interface between mantle and germinal center appears irregular
61940.describe_en: High-power IgD immunostain shows a band of small lymphocytes with membranous IgD staining streaming alongside and into a zone of larger IgD-negative germinal center cells with vesicular nuclei. Two isolated cells with intense cytoplasmic IgD staining, likely plasma cells, are present in the germinal center area. The irregular intermingling of IgD-positive mantle cells with germinal center cells supports progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles show a sharp, circumferential IgD-positive mantle clearly separated from the germinal center, whereas PTGC shows mantle cells infiltrating the center.
Separation relies on finding large LP cells (CD20+, OCT2+) within nodules, which are not identifiable in this field.
MCL IgD+ cells are monomorphic with slightly irregular nuclei and cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity, which reactive mantle cells lack.

61876.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色的原始細胞群（P5）位於 CD45 中低表現、低側向散射區，對 CD13、CD33、CD117、CD11b、CD64、HLA-DR 等骨髓系標記及 CD19、CD20、CD10 等 B 系標記均為陰性，僅 CD38 陽性；排除 Burkitt 與骨髓系白血病，需再以 T 系標記確認。
features: Blast gate (red, P5) with dim-to-intermediate CD45 and low side scatter, distinct from lymphocytes (blue, P3) and granulocytes/monocytes (green, P4)
Blasts negative for myeloid markers CD13, CD33, CD117, CD11b, CD11c, CD64 and CD14
Blasts negative for B-lineage markers CD19, CD20 and CD10
Blasts negative for CD34, HLA-DR and CD56
Blasts bright CD38 positive
61876.describe_en: Multiparameter flow cytometry plots from a B/myeloid screening tube show an abnormal blast population (red, P5) with dim-to-intermediate CD45 and low side scatter, separate from mature lymphocytes (blue) and myeloid cells (green). The red population is negative for myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117, CD11b, CD11c, CD64, CD14), B-lineage markers (CD19, CD20, CD10), CD34, HLA-DR and CD56, and is brightly CD38 positive. This lineage-negative profile excludes Burkitt lymphoma and AML and mandates a T-cell panel; subsequent T-lineage markers (cytoplasmic/surface CD3, CD1a, CD2, CD5, CD7, CD4/CD8 co-expression) established T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are CD19, CD20 and CD10 positive with surface light-chain restriction, whereas this population is negative for all B-lineage markers.
AML blasts typically express CD13, CD33, CD117 and/or HLA-DR, all of which are negative here.
B-ALL blasts express CD19 with CD10 and often CD34, which are absent in this population.
BPDCN expresses CD4, CD56, CD123 and HLA-DR, whereas these blasts are CD56 and HLA-DR negative.

61812.recognize_zh: NPM1 免疫染色（紅色呈色）中，成片母細胞除細胞核外，細胞質也呈紅色陽性（NPM1 細胞質異位表現），分裂中的細胞染色最強，而小淋巴球僅見藍色核，提示 NPM1 突變。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with oval to indented nuclei
Red chromogen staining in both nuclei and cytoplasm of most blasts (cytoplasmic NPM1 delocalization)
Mitotic figures with intense diffuse cytoplasmic staining
Scattered small lymphocytes with only blue counterstained nuclei as internal negative cells
Minimal residual normal hematopoiesis in this field
61812.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for nucleophosmin (NPM1, red chromogen) on a marrow section involved by sheets of blasts shows aberrant cytoplasmic staining in addition to nuclear staining in the majority of blasts, with intense staining of mitotic cells. Small lymphocytes serve as internal cells lacking cytoplasmic signal. Aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1 localization is a reliable surrogate for NPM1 mutation. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation arising in the setting of germline GATA2 mutation; confirmation by molecular testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Wild-type NPM1 shows nucleus-restricted (nucleolar) staining without cytoplasmic signal.
Cytoplasmic staining in mitoses alone is physiologic after nuclear membrane breakdown, so interphase blasts must show cytoplasmic positivity to call NPM1 mutation.

ddx.dx: ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma with NPM1-ALK
ddx.vs: NPM1-ALK fusion causes cytoplasmic ALK and NPM staining in CD30-positive lymphoid cells, not in myeloid blasts.

61748.recognize_zh: BCL2 免疫染色中大多數中小型淋巴樣細胞呈強的細胞質與核膜周圍棕色陽性，排列成片狀，僅少數細長基質細胞與內皮細胞為藍色陰性；腫瘤性 B 細胞 BCL2 陽性符合脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤，但此標記本身不具特異性。
features: Strong perinuclear and cytoplasmic BCL2 staining in the majority of small to medium lymphoid cells
Positive cells arranged in dense sheets with a streaming pattern
Scattered BCL2-negative spindle stromal/endothelial cells and some large cells with blue nuclei
Nuclei of positive cells are round to slightly irregular with a crisp ring of cytoplasmic staining
No germinal center-like BCL2-negative zones in this field
61748.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows strong cytoplasmic and perinuclear staining in the majority of small to medium lymphoid cells forming a diffuse infiltrate, while scattered spindle stromal and endothelial cells are negative. No BCL2-negative reactive germinal centers are present in this field. BCL2 expression is expected in most low-grade B-cell lymphomas and in normal mantle and marginal zone B cells, so the stain is supportive but not specific. In the context of the morphology and light-chain restriction in this case, the findings are consistent with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Is also BCL2 positive, but neoplastic cells co-express CD10 and BCL6 within follicles and carry t(14;18).
Germinal center B cells are BCL2 negative, whereas mantle and marginal zone cells and T cells remain positive.
Is BCL2 positive as well, so distinction rests on cyclin D1, SOX11 and CD5 positivity.
Is characteristically BCL2 negative or weak with CD10 positivity and a Ki-67 index near 100%.

61684.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD7 對 CD2），非形態影像；大部分藍色族群為 CD2 陽性並伴隨強 CD7 表現，但有一部分延伸到 CD2 較弱，可用來確認這群 T 細胞保留全 T 細胞抗原。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD7-APC700 (x-axis) versus CD2-PC7 (y-axis), gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue population with bright CD7 (about 10^1.5 to 10^2) and CD2 expression spanning from dim (about 10^0) to moderate (about 10^1.5)
Overlapping green events within the CD2+CD7+ cluster
Magenta and red events with CD2 expression and dimmer to negative CD7, extending leftward
Small green/magenta CD2-negative, CD7-negative population near the origin
61684.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD7 versus CD2 expression within the gated population. The dominant population (blue) expresses bright CD7 with CD2 expression that is mostly moderate but trails into a dimmer subset, while a separate CD2-positive population with dim to negative CD7 (magenta/red) is also present. A small double-negative population sits near the origin. The expression of pan-T antigens CD2 and bright CD7 on the dominant population supports a mature T-cell neoplasm such as T-prolymphocytic leukemia; partial dimming of CD2 is best interpreted together with the other markers in the panel.

61620.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見紅血球大小不一，混有少數較大且顏色較淡的紅血球與部分拉長或淚滴狀細胞，嗜中性球分葉正常、血小板足量；變化輕微且非特異，需搭配 MCV/RDW 與骨髓鐵染色判讀。
features: Mild anisocytosis with scattered larger, paler red cells suggesting a minor dimorphic population
Occasional elliptocytes and a teardrop-shaped cell
Single neutrophil with normal lobation and granulation
Adequate platelets with normal morphology
No blasts, basophilic stippling, or Pappenheimer bodies convincingly identified at this resolution
61620.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisocytosis, including scattered larger and paler cells that suggest a subtle dimorphic population, along with occasional elliptocytes and a teardrop form. The single neutrophil present shows normal lobation and granulation, and platelets are adequate. No blasts are seen. These findings are nonspecific; in the setting of anemia with an elevated RDW, they are compatible with, but not diagnostic of, MDS with ring sideroblasts, which requires bone marrow iron staining and SF3B1 testing.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency produces uniformly microcytic hypochromic cells with pencil cells and low ferritin, rather than a subtle dimorphic population.
A dimorphic picture from recent transfusion or partially treated deficiency is identified by clinical history and iron/B12 studies.
X-linked (ALAS2) sideroblastic anemia shows marked microcytic hypochromic cells from childhood and responds to pyridoxine, unlike acquired clonal MDS-RS.

61492.recognize_zh: 中倍下骨髓組織富含造血細胞，脂肪空泡間散布多顆大型、核分葉的巨核細胞，彼此分開不成群，且無纖維化或異常浸潤，符合 ITP 的巨核細胞增生。
features: Hypercellular-appearing marrow fragment with interspersed fat vacuoles
Megakaryocytes increased and evenly scattered as single cells, not clustered or paratrabecular
Megakaryocytes large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and multilobated nuclei
Trilineage hematopoiesis with many erythroid precursors and granulocytes in background
No fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates or granulomas in this field
61492.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular fragment with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed adipocytes. Megakaryocytes are increased and scattered singly throughout the interstitium; they are large, with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and multilobated nuclei, and lack clustering or significant atypia. There is no evidence of fibrosis, granulomatous inflammation or an infiltrative process in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic hyperplasia as seen in immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: ET has loose clusters of very large megakaryocytes with hyperlobated staghorn nuclei and thrombocytosis, whereas here megakaryocytes are dispersed and the patient is thrombocytopenic.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia (e.g., infection, blood loss)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; the distinction is clinical, relying on the context of isolated immune-mediated thrombocytopenia.
MDS shows small hypolobated megakaryocytes and dysplasia in erythroid or granulocytic lineages, not seen here.

61428.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央可見一至兩顆巨噬細胞，胞質內及周圍散布大量小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），伴隨拖曳的核絲與破碎細胞，符合利什曼原蟲感染。
features: Central macrophage(s) with numerous small uniform oval purple amastigotes within and around the cytoplasm
Organisms about 2-4 um; kinetoplast not clearly resolved at this magnification
Adjacent clusters of erythroblasts and maturing granulocytes
Smearing artifact with stretched nuclear strands and disrupted cells
No intraerythrocytic parasites
61428.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and scattered smudged cells with stretched nuclear strands. In the center, macrophages contain and are surrounded by numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular organisms. The nucleus-kinetoplast pair is not clearly resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies, supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo, no kinetoplast and positive GMS/PAS staining.
Talaromyces yeasts have central transverse septa from fission and no kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic and lack a kinetoplast.

61364.recognize_zh: 一群大型紅血球母細胞，細胞質深藍、核圓、染色質細緻，多數細胞質內有大小一致的透亮小空泡（punched-out vacuoles），此為異常早期紅系前驅細胞的特徵；是否達急性紅系白血病需依原紅血球母細胞比例判定。
features: Cluster of large erythroid precursors (pronormoblasts) with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple sharply punched-out clear vacuoles, sometimes forming a perinuclear ring
Cytoplasmic blebbing and irregular borders in some cells
Adjacent eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and orange granules; small dark degenerating cells in the cluster
61364.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large pronormoblasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete clear vacuoles. An eosinophil is present adjacent to the cluster. Vacuolated early erythroid precursors are a dysplastic feature seen in myeloid neoplasms with erythroid predominance. Classification depends on quantitation: with pronormoblasts below 30% of nucleated cells and 7% myeloblasts, as reported in this case, the findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic neoplasm with increased blasts (MDS-EB-1) rather than pure erythroid leukemia; TP53 status and karyotype should be assessed.

ddx.vs: Requires at least 30% pronormoblasts with erythroid predominance (at least 80%), so the distinction is quantitative rather than cytologic.
Megaloblasts show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin in maturing cells, without vacuolated basophilic blasts, and correct with B12/folate.
Cause vacuolization of erythroid and myeloid precursors with ringed sideroblasts, but without increased myeloblasts and resolve with correction.
Burkitt cells also have deep blue vacuolated cytoplasm but are mature B cells (CD19/CD20, surface light chain) that lack erythroid markers.

61300.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球大多大小一致、中央淡染區不明顯擴大，僅散見少數標靶細胞（target cell），白血球（嗜中性球、淋巴球）與血小板形態正常；這類輕微變化本身不能診斷血紅素 D，需靠血紅素電泳。
features: Red cells relatively uniform in size with mild microcytosis difficult to appreciate
Scattered target cells, subtle at this magnification
No sickle cells, spherocytes, or significant fragmentation
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophil and small lymphocytes
Adequate platelets with some small clumps
61300.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a red cell population that is relatively uniform in size with only scattered target cells; sickle cells, spherocytes, and schistocytes are not identified. A segmented neutrophil and lymphocytes appear morphologically normal, and platelets are adequate with small clumps. These findings are mild and nonspecific. In conjunction with hemoglobin electrophoresis showing a D-window variant, they are consistent with heterozygous hemoglobin D.

ddx.vs: Hb C trait shows more numerous target cells, and electrophoresis places the variant in the C/A2 zone rather than the D zone.
Thalassemia trait shows more obvious microcytosis with elevated RBC count and basophilic stippling, and Hb A2 is increased in beta-thalassemia trait.
Acquired target cells are accompanied by macrocytosis or Howell-Jolly bodies and a normal hemoglobin electrophoresis.

61236.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中可見一顆核分成六葉以上的過度分葉中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil），背景紅血球有明顯大小不一與異形（箭頭處淚滴形、碎片狀細胞），合起來提示維生素 B12 缺乏的巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Hypersegmented neutrophil with at least six nuclear lobes
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells (dacrocytes) and irregular fragmented forms (arrows)
Scattered oval macrocytes interspersed with smaller poikilocytes
Red cells with preserved central pallor; no nucleated red cells in the field
Occasional small platelets; overall low red cell density
61236.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells and irregular fragmented or pointed red cells (arrows), admixed with oval macrocytes. A hypersegmented neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes is present. Red cell density is low, consistent with anemia. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, such as vitamin B12 deficiency due to pernicious anemia; confirmatory tests include serum B12/folate, methylmalonic acid, homocysteine and anti-intrinsic factor antibodies.

ddx.vs: Teardrop cells are accompanied by a leukoerythroblastic picture with nucleated red cells and immature myeloid cells, without hypersegmented neutrophils or oval macrocytes.
Macrocytosis with dysplasia shows hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger) and hypogranular neutrophils rather than hypersegmentation, with normal B12/folate.
Schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles) predominate with thrombocytopenia, and neutrophils are not hypersegmented.

61172.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被許多大小不一、邊界清楚、彼此緊密相鄰的淡粉紅色上皮樣肉芽腫取代，中央無壞死，周圍是深藍色的淋巴球，這種「裸露」（naked）非乾酪性肉芽腫是類肉瘤（sarcoidosis）的典型低倍影像。
features: Numerous well-formed, discrete to confluent granulomas of varying size replacing much of the lymph node
Granulomas composed of pale eosinophilic epithelioid histiocytes, sharply demarcated with only a thin lymphocytic rim ('naked' granulomas)
No central caseous necrosis in any granuloma
Occasional multinucleated giant cells discernible within granulomas (e.g., upper center)
Intervening residual dark-blue lymphoid tissue between granulomas
61172.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows extensive replacement of the parenchyma by numerous, closely packed, well-circumscribed granulomas of variable size. The granulomas are composed of pale epithelioid histiocytes with occasional multinucleated giant cells and have a scant lymphocytic cuff, with residual lymphoid tissue in between. No caseous necrosis is identified. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis, compatible with sarcoidosis after exclusion of mycobacterial and fungal infection by special stains and culture.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas are less uniform, frequently coalesce around central caseous necrosis, and may show AFB-positive organisms.
Toxoplasmosis shows small, ill-defined epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on reactive follicles with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, not large discrete confluent granulomas.
Cat-scratch granulomas are stellate and suppurative with central neutrophilic microabscesses.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells (CD30+, CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background between granulomas.

61108.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有一片淡染區域，由大型多角形細胞組成，胞質呈細顆粒狀、多泡狀嗜酸性，核小而居中（B），與一般單一大空泡的白色脂肪細胞不同；免疫染色中這些細胞強陽性（C）、組織球標記則為弱或陰性（D），支持棕色脂肪組織而非儲積性組織球。
features: Low power: paler, hypocellular region of the core distinct from adjacent hematopoietic marrow
Large polygonal cells with abundant finely granular to microvacuolated eosinophilic cytoplasm
Small, round, centrally placed nuclei, some with a visible nucleolus
Scattered small hematopoietic cells and delicate capillaries between the cells
Immunostain C: strong cytoplasmic/nuclear staining of the large cells (antigen not labeled)
Immunostain D: large cells weak to negative, with separate strongly positive histiocytes highlighted in the inset
61108.describe_en: Composite figure. Low-power H&E of the bone marrow core shows a pale, relatively hypocellular region adjacent to normocellular hematopoietic marrow. At high power, this region is composed of large polygonal cells with abundant multivacuolated, granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and small central nuclei, lacking the single large lipid vacuole of white adipocytes. The large cells are strongly highlighted by one immunostain and are weak to negative with a second stain that labels background histiocytes. There is no cytologic atypia or mitotic activity. Findings are consistent with incidental brown adipose tissue in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary wrinkled-tissue-paper cytoplasm with eccentric nuclei and are CD68/CD163-positive, whereas brown fat cells are multivacuolated and S100/UCP1-positive.
Serous atrophy shows extracellular pale amorphous mucopolysaccharide material with atrophic fat cells rather than cohesive multivacuolated granular cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic clear/granular cell carcinoma (e.g., renal cell carcinoma)
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells show nuclear atypia and cytokeratin/PAX8 positivity, whereas brown fat cells have bland central nuclei and are keratin-negative.

ddx.dx: Granular cell tumor or histiocytic storage disorder
ddx.vs: Granular cell tumor has PAS-diastase-resistant granules without microvacuoles, and storage histiocytes express CD68/CD163.

61044.recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓出現大量小至中型、核形不規則甚至有裂痕或雙葉的非典型淋巴球，切片瀰漫浸潤；免疫染色 CD20、CD5 陽性、CD3 陰性，SOX11 強核陽性且 Ki-67 高，即使 cyclin D1 陰性仍支持母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Peripheral blood with numerous small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, cleaved to bilobed/binucleated-appearing nuclei with slightly condensed chromatin
Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy with diffuse sheets of similar atypical lymphoid cells
IHC: diffuse CD20 and CD5 positivity with CD3 highlighting only scattered T cells
Strong nuclear SOX11 in most tumor cells and high Ki-67 proliferation index
61044.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood contains numerous atypical small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular, cleaved and bilobed nuclear contours. The bone marrow aspirate and biopsy show diffuse replacement by similar cells. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are CD20-positive and CD5-positive, CD3 marks only scattered reactive T cells, SOX11 shows strong nuclear staining, and the Ki-67 proliferation index is high. In the stated absence of cyclin D1 protein and CCND1 rearrangement, findings are consistent with cyclin D1-negative, SOX11-positive blastoid mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FL cells are CD10+/BCL6+, CD5-negative and SOX11-negative with IGH::BCL2.
ATLL 'flower cells' are CD3+/CD4+/CD25+ T cells with HTLV-1 serology, not CD20+ B cells.
CLL is CD5+/CD23+ with dim FMC7 and SOX11-negative, and cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin rather than cleaved nuclei.
B-ALL blasts express TdT/CD34, lack surface light chain, and are CD5-negative.

61044.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC: CD20, CD5, CD3, SOX11, Ki-67

60980.recognize_zh: 移植後周邊血與骨髓出現大量母細胞（核染色質細、可見核仁、細胞質嗜鹼性），核型分析顯示異常克隆帶有第 2、12 號染色體轉位與第 11 號染色體結構異常，且性染色體組成（插圖 X/Y 框）與捐贈者一致，提示為捐贈者來源的骨髓腫瘤。
features: Panel A (PB): several circulating blasts with high N:C ratio, dense-appearing round nuclei and deep basophilic cytoplasm among normal red cells

Panel D (BM aspirate): sheets of medium-to-large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and moderate pale-blue agranular cytoplasm; occasional binucleate forms
Panel B: G-banded karyogram of the abnormal clone
Panel C: partial karyograms highlighting a translocation between chromosomes 2 and 12 (brackets) and a structural rearrangement of chromosome 11 (dashed bracket)
Inset: sex chromosome pair used to establish donor origin (sex-mismatched transplant)
60980.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts, and the bone marrow aspirate is extensively replaced by medium-to-large blasts with fine chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli and moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm, with occasional binucleate forms and few residual maturing myeloid cells. G-banded karyotype of the neoplastic clone shows structural abnormalities including a translocation involving chromosomes 2 and 12 and a rearrangement of chromosome 11, and the sex chromosome complement (inset) corresponds to the donor rather than the recipient. In the post-allogeneic transplant setting, the findings are consistent with a donor-derived myeloid neoplasm (acute leukemia), which should be confirmed by chimerism/STR analysis and flow cytometric lineage assignment.

ddx.dx: Relapse of the original recipient-derived leukemia
ddx.vs: Recipient relapse carries the recipient's sex chromosomes/STR profile and often the original cytogenetic lesion, whereas this clone has the donor genotype with new abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm of recipient origin
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar with complex/11q23 abnormalities, but chimerism studies show recipient origin.

ddx.dx: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder or lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: Blasts would express B- or T-lineage markers (and EBV in PTLD) rather than myeloid markers on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Regenerating marrow with left shift after transplant
ddx.vs: Recovery shows orderly maturation with <5% blasts and a normal donor karyotype, not sheets of blasts with a clonal abnormality.

60916.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片真皮與皮下有密集的中大型多形性淋巴樣細胞浸潤；周邊血液中（箭頭）出現核不規則、染色質粗、細胞質偏藍的異型淋巴球；骨髓切片同樣被異型細胞浸潤，免疫染色 TCRβ 陰性而 TCRγ 陽性，確認為 γ/δ T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Skin: dense dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphoid cells beneath the epidermis, surrounding adnexa
High power skin: medium-to-large pleomorphic cells with irregular, convoluted nuclei and coarse chromatin
Peripheral blood: circulating atypical lymphocytes with irregular to folded nuclei, condensed chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm (arrows)
Bone marrow biopsy: interstitial infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei among residual hematopoiesis
IHC: TCRβ essentially negative, TCRγ positive with membranous/cytoplasmic staining
60916.describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate of medium-to-large pleomorphic lymphoid cells with irregular, convoluted nuclei and coarse chromatin. The peripheral blood smear contains increased circulating atypical lymphocytes with irregular to folded nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow biopsy is infiltrated by similar atypical lymphoid cells among residual hematopoietic elements. The neoplastic cells are negative for TCRβ and positive for TCRγ. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous γ/δ T-cell lymphoma with peripheral blood and bone marrow involvement.

ddx.vs: MF shows epidermotropic CD4+ αβ T cells (TCRβ positive) and Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclei, whereas these cells are TCRγ positive and TCRβ negative.
Also γδ, but presents with hepatosplenomegaly and sinusoidal marrow involvement without primary skin lesions.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8+ aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Shows pagetoid epidermotropism by CD8+ TCRβ-positive cells rather than TCRγ-positive cells.
Angiocentric, EBER positive and typically surface CD3 negative with no TCRγ expression.

60852.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結 CD1a 免疫染色中，強陽性的細胞以膜狀染色呈寬帶狀、網狀分布於淋巴竇與濾泡間區，包圍著陰性的淋巴濾泡，顯示竇內擴張的蘭格漢斯細胞，符合淋巴結 LCH。
features: Low-power lymph node with broad, anastomosing bands of strongly CD1a-positive cells distending sinuses and interfollicular areas
Crisp membranous and cytoplasmic CD1a staining of large lesional cells
CD1a-negative lymphoid follicles and paracortical small lymphocytes in the intervening pale blue areas
Faint background staining within germinal centers (likely nonspecific/dendritic meshwork)
Sinusoidal distribution pattern preserved
60852.describe_en: Low-power CD1a immunohistochemistry on a lymph node shows strong membranous staining of large lesional cells forming broad, interconnected bands that distend the sinuses and extend into interfollicular regions, surrounding CD1a-negative lymphoid follicles and background lymphocytes. Only faint nonspecific staining is seen in germinal centers. The sinusoidal pattern and strong CD1a positivity of the infiltrating cells support Langerhans cell histiocytosis involving the lymph node.

ddx.vs: Dermatopathic change shows scattered CD1a+ Langerhans cells in expanded paracortical nodules with melanin-laden macrophages, rather than confluent sheets filling the sinuses.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes also distend sinuses but are CD1a and langerin negative, S-100 positive, and show emperipolesis.
Reactive sinus histiocytes are CD68/CD163 positive and CD1a negative.
Langerhans cell sarcoma shares CD1a/langerin but has overtly malignant cytology with marked atypia and high mitotic rate.

60788.recognize_zh: 大片中至大型、核卵圓且泡狀的腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫性 CD10 陽性（棕色膜/細胞質染色），左下角小型背景淋巴球則為陰性，支持生發中心來源（GCB）的瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-to-large cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei
Moderate-to-strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD10 staining in most large cells
Occasional dot-like/Golgi-pattern accentuation of CD10 staining
Small background lymphocytes and stromal/endothelial cells (lower left) are CD10 negative, serving as internal negative control
No residual follicular architecture evident in this field
60788.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD10 on a biopsy of a bone lesion shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular oval nuclei. The large neoplastic cells show moderate-to-strong membranous and granular cytoplasmic CD10 positivity, whereas admixed small lymphocytes and stromal cells are negative. In the context of a diffuse large B-cell proliferation (Ki-67 about 50%, BCL2 strong, MUM1 variable, MYC not overexpressed per history), findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, germinal center B-cell subtype by the Hans algorithm, presenting as primary bone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Also CD10 positive, but shows monotonous medium-sized cells with a starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100%, BCL2 negativity and MYC rearrangement, unlike this BCL2-strong case with Ki-67 about 50%.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Can be CD10+/BCL2+ GCB-type, so FISH for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 is required; morphology and IHC alone cannot exclude it.
Also CD10 positive and common in bone in children, but cells have fine blastic chromatin and express TdT and often CD34, with weak or absent CD20 and surface immunoglobulin.

ddx.dx: Ewing sarcoma / small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Lacks CD20/CD45 and shows membranous CD99 with NKX2-2 and EWSR1 rearrangement rather than B-cell markers.

60596.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中早期紅血球前驅細胞（原紅血球）與顆粒球前驅細胞的細胞質內有多個小圓形空泡，這種早期前驅細胞空泡化是銅缺乏（或酒精、linezolid）造成貧血的線索。
features: Early erythroid precursor (pronormoblast) with round nucleus, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple small, discrete, round cytoplasmic vacuoles, some at the cell periphery
Myeloid precursor (panel B) with similar cytoplasmic vacuolation
Adjacent neutrophils and myelocytes without significant dysplasia; platelets in background
60596.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows early erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small, sharply defined vacuoles, and a myeloid precursor with similar cytoplasmic vacuolation. Neighboring maturing granulocytes lack overt dysplasia in these fields. Vacuolization of early erythroid and myeloid precursors is suggestive of copper deficiency, with alcohol, linezolid/chloramphenicol exposure and zinc excess as alternative causes; iron stain for ring sideroblasts and serum copper/ceruloplasmin and zinc levels are recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS shows multilineage dysplasia and clonal cytogenetic/molecular changes, while copper deficiency vacuoles resolve with copper repletion and occur with low serum copper.
Produces identical precursor vacuoles; exposure history and normal copper levels discriminate.

ddx.dx: Acute erythroid leukemia / pure erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia has sheets (>80%) of vacuolated pronormoblasts with PAS-positive vacuoles and TP53 mutation, not scattered vacuolated precursors amid normal maturation.
Artifactual vacuoles affect mature neutrophils and monocytes diffusely, rather than selectively involving early erythroid and myeloid precursors in a fresh aspirate.

60660.recognize_zh: A 圖組織切片中鱗狀上皮下方的出血性間質內有深染、不典型的大型淋巴樣細胞浸潤；B 圖骨髓切片脂肪間散布許多細胞核呈深黑色訊號的大型細胞，符合 EBV（EBER ISH）陽性的淋巴瘤細胞，支持 HIV 相關、EBV 驅動的瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯。
features: Panel A: squamous epithelium adjacent to hemorrhagic stroma infiltrated by atypical, dark-staining large lymphoid cells
Extensive extravasated red cells within the stroma; image color cast limits nuclear detail
Panel B: marrow biopsy with prominent adipocytes and interstitial scattered large cells
Dense dark black-purple nuclear signal in many of the large cells, consistent with EBER in situ hybridization (chromogen not labeled)
Residual background marrow cells with reddish counterstain
60660.describe_en: Tissue section (panel A) shows squamous mucosa with an underlying hemorrhagic stroma infiltrated by atypical, hyperchromatic large lymphoid cells; the yellow color cast of the image limits cytologic detail. The marrow biopsy (panel B) shows a fatty marrow in which numerous large cells display dark nuclear signal, consistent with EBER in situ hybridization highlighting EBV-infected tumor cells (the stain is not labeled in the image). No specific B-cell marker staining is shown. In an HIV-positive patient, findings are consistent with EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving mucosa and bone marrow, a setting in which a high tumor burden can cause type B lactic acidosis (Warburg effect).

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is also EBER positive and common in HIV oral mucosa, but tumor cells lack CD20/PAX5 and express CD138, MUM1, and CD38.
PEL cells are HHV-8 (LANA) positive, often co-infected with EBV, and lack B-cell markers, whereas EBV-positive DLBCL is HHV-8 negative and CD20 positive.
Burkitt lymphoma shows sheets of medium-sized cells with a starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 near 100%, and MYC rearrangement with a CD10/BCL6-positive, BCL2-negative phenotype.
Carcinoma arises from the epithelium with keratin-positive cohesive nests and is EBER negative (outside nasopharyngeal sites), unlike discohesive CD45/CD20-positive lymphoma cells.

60724.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中有一個結節狀淋巴球聚集，外觀似良性淋巴聚集；但 B 細胞標記整個結節陽性，D 的核染色陽性細胞（符合 cyclin D1）集中在結節外圍呈環狀分布，代表早期套細胞淋巴瘤以類似套區 (mantle zone) 的型態侵犯骨髓。
features: Panel A (H&E): well-circumscribed nodular lymphoid aggregate of small lymphocytes in a normocellular marrow, paratrabecular location not evident
Panel B (IHC, unlabeled): diffuse strong staining of the entire aggregate, consistent with a B-cell marker
Panel C (IHC, unlabeled): strong staining in a peripheral rim and scattered cells within the aggregate center
Panel D (IHC, unlabeled): nuclear staining in a subset of cells concentrated in a ring at the periphery of the aggregate (pattern fits cyclin D1)
Small cell size without large cells or proliferation centers
60724.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular nodular aggregate of small lymphocytes. Immunostains (markers not labeled in the figure) show diffuse staining of the aggregate with a B-cell-type marker, a second marker highlighting a peripheral rim and scattered central cells, and nuclear positivity in cells arranged in a ring at the periphery of the nodule. In context, findings are consistent with early/limited bone marrow involvement by mantle cell lymphoma in a mantle zone-like pattern; cyclin D1 staining is essential because such aggregates can be mistaken for benign lymphoid aggregates.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, well circumscribed and composed of mixed T and B cells with no cyclin D1-positive population.
CLL nodules are CD5+/CD23+/LEF1+ and cyclin D1 negative, with proliferation centers.
FL nodules are typically paratrabecular and CD10/BCL6 positive without cyclin D1.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with cyclin D1
ddx.vs: Cyclin D1+ myeloma cells are CD138+ plasma cells in interstitial sheets rather than a CD20+ lymphoid nodule.

60532.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中，一片密集的小至中型淋巴細胞浸潤延伸到脂肪與纖維組織，其間夾雜淡染、細胞質豐富的類上皮組織球小簇；本放大倍率下類上皮細胞不算明顯，典型 Lennert 淋巴瘤特徵須以高倍與 T 細胞免疫染色確認。
features: Dense diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
Scattered small clusters of pale epithelioid histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm in the central zone
Infiltrate extends into adjacent adipose tissue, surrounding individual fat cells
Collagenous fibrous tissue in the upper field infiltrated by the same cells
No follicles or granulomas with necrosis identified in this field
60532.describe_en: Section at medium power shows a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei, extending into surrounding fibrous tissue and adipose tissue where it encircles individual fat cells. Small, ill-defined clusters of pale epithelioid histiocytes are interspersed within the infiltrate, but they are not conspicuous at this magnification. No residual follicles or necrosis are seen. The image supports a diffuse atypical lymphoid infiltrate with extranodal/perinodal extension; in the context of the title it is compatible with lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, which requires high-power assessment and T-cell immunophenotyping with clonality studies.

ddx.vs: Mixed cellularity Hodgkin lymphoma contains diagnostic CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells within the epithelioid-rich background.
AITL has prominent arborizing high endothelial venules, clear cells, and expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks with TFH markers.
Reactive lymphadenitis retains nodal architecture and follicles and lacks cytologic atypia or clonal TCR rearrangement.
SLL cells are round, CD5+/CD23+ B cells forming proliferation centers rather than an atypical T-cell infiltrate with epithelioid histiocytes.

60468.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD21 免疫染色下，可見大量緊密相鄰、形狀不規則且互相融合的濾泡狀區域，內含濃密的濾泡樹突細胞網（FDC meshwork），間隔以陰性的濾泡間區；證明腫瘤仍保有濾泡結構，是將大細胞病灶歸類為濾泡性淋巴瘤而非瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的依據。
features: Low-power view of numerous closely packed follicle-shaped CD21-positive areas
Dense, expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks within nodules
Nodules are irregular, back-to-back and focally confluent with jagged outlines
Narrow CD21-negative interfollicular zones between nodules
Residual less-involved area at upper right with sparser staining
60468.describe_en: Low-power CD21 immunohistochemical stain shows numerous closely packed, irregular and focally confluent nodules containing dense follicular dendritic cell meshworks, separated by narrow CD21-negative interfollicular zones. The nodules are back-to-back and replace most of the field. The preserved FDC meshworks confirm a follicular growth pattern; in a lesion composed of sheets of centroblasts, this supports follicular lymphoma, grade 3B, rather than diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse effacement with absent or only fragmented residual CD21-positive meshworks rather than intact expanded follicles.
Reactive follicles are more widely spaced, variable in size with preserved mantle zones, and the germinal center B cells are BCL2-negative.

ddx.dx: Nodular marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Colonized follicles show disrupted meshworks with CD10/BCL6-negative marginal zone cells expanding around them.
AITL shows irregular expanded FDC meshworks outside follicles surrounding high endothelial venules, with a PD1/CXCL13-positive T-cell infiltrate.

60276.recognize_zh: 壞死區內充滿核碎裂碎屑與紅血球，散在的腫大細胞核呈毛玻璃樣淡紫色、染色質被推向核膜（margination），部分核內有被透明暈包圍的嗜伊紅包涵體（Cowdry A），這些病毒細胞病變是 HSV 淋巴結炎的關鍵線索。
features: Extensive necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear dust and fibrinous eosinophilic background
Scattered enlarged cells with homogeneous, glassy amphophilic ('ground-glass') nuclei and peripheral chromatin margination
Occasional eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo (Cowdry type A)
Some virally infected cells show nuclear molding or multinucleation
Extravasated red cells; no viable lymphoid sheets or granulomas in this field
60276.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows extensive necrosis composed of abundant karyorrhectic debris, fibrinous material and extravasated red cells. Scattered enlarged cells within the necrosis display glassy amphophilic nuclei with margination of chromatin, and several contain eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions surrounded by a clear halo (Cowdry type A), with occasional nuclear molding. No granulomas or sheets of viable atypical lymphoid cells are present in this field. Findings are consistent with herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis, which can be confirmed with HSV-1/2 immunohistochemistry or PCR.

ddx.vs: VZV produces identical Cowdry A inclusions and multinucleation, so HSV-1/2 versus VZV immunohistochemistry or PCR is required.
CMV causes cytomegaly with a single large 'owl's-eye' intranuclear inclusion plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions, without nuclear molding or ground-glass multinucleation.
Kikuchi necrosis has crescentic histiocytes and karyorrhexis but lacks viral intranuclear inclusions.
RS cells have large eosinophilic macronucleoli rather than glassy nuclei with haloed inclusions and are CD30/CD15-positive.

60148.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片在骨小樑之間幾乎被一片片單調、密集的中型芽細胞取代，脂肪與正常三系造血所剩無幾，僅左側可見零星巨核細胞；形態只能判定為急性白血病浸潤，是否為混合表現型（MPAL）需靠流式或免疫染色。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement of intertrabecular spaces
Diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized cells with round to oval nuclei, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm (blasts)
Marked reduction of normal trilineage hematopoiesis; rare residual megakaryocytes at the left
Very little residual fat; a less cellular area with loose stroma at the top of the field
Bony trabeculae intact without evident fibrosis at this power
60148.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows a markedly hypercellular marrow for age, with the intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized blasts with round to oval nuclei, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced, with only rare residual megakaryocytes and minimal fat. Bony trabeculae are intact and no fibrosis is evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute leukemia; lineage assignment requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry (MPO, CD19, CD79a, CD3), and with co-expression of myeloid and B-lymphoid markers and KMT2A rearrangement, the findings support mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML blasts may look identical on H&E, so separation relies on immunophenotype showing only myeloid/monocytic markers without lineage-defining B- or T-cell markers.
B-ALL has a similar sheet-like pattern but blasts are MPO-negative and lack monocytic differentiation, expressing CD19, CD79a, PAX5 and TdT.
Lymphoma cells often show a starry-sky pattern or larger vesicular nuclei with mature B-cell phenotype (TdT-negative, surface light chain-positive).
Myeloma infiltrates consist of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm that are CD138-positive with light-chain restriction.

60084.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下芽細胞之間散布許多小型巨核細胞，核只有單葉或兩葉（hypolobated/monolobated）、細胞質粉紅；大量小而低分葉的異常巨核細胞配上芽細胞增加，是 inv(3)/t(3;3) AML 的經典線索。
features: Numerous small megakaryocytes with monolobated or bilobed (hypolobated) nuclei and pink cytoplasm
Some megakaryocytes with widely separated nuclear lobes
Background sheets of immature cells with high N:C ratio and dark irregular nuclei
Scattered erythroid precursors and red cells; loosely cohesive section with retraction artifact
Megakaryocytes are clustered and increased relative to normal
60084.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine core biopsy at high power shows numerous small megakaryocytes with monolobated or bilobed nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, some with separated nuclear lobes, set among sheets of immature cells with high N:C ratio. Scattered residual erythroid precursors are present, and the section shows retraction artifact. The prominence of small hypolobated megakaryocytes is a characteristic dysplastic feature. In conjunction with increased blasts and inv(3)(q21q26.2), findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(3)/MECOM rearrangement.

ddx.vs: del(5q) MDS also shows small monolobated megakaryocytes, but blasts are fewer than 5% and platelets are often normal or increased.
CML shows small hypolobated 'dwarf' megakaryocytes with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and BCR::ABL1, not sheets of blasts.
MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated or bulbous nuclei rather than small and hypolobated.

60020.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆小到中型母細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻、核輪廓平滑至略不規則、僅有極少量淡藍色細胞質，且無 Auer 小體或顆粒；單憑型態無法判定系別，需流式細胞儀才可診斷未分化型急性白血病。
features: Two small to intermediate blasts, roughly 1.5 times red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with scant pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly angulated nuclear contours with fine chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Background red cells include target cells; platelets present
60020.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small to intermediate blasts with a very high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, smooth to slightly irregular nuclear contours, and scant agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods are identified. Red cells include scattered target cells, and platelets are present. The morphology is nonspecific and does not permit lineage assignment; cytochemistry and comprehensive flow cytometry are required. In this case, with absence of lineage-specific markers, the findings are consistent with acute undifferentiated leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts look identical morphologically; expression of CD19 with cCD79a/CD10 or cytoplasmic CD3 by flow cytometry excludes AUL.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are similarly agranular but express myeloid markers (CD13, CD33, CD117) despite MPO negativity, whereas AUL lacks these.
BPDCN blasts may have cytoplasmic vacuoles or pseudopods and express CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4, which must be excluded before calling AUL.

ddx.dx: Mature lymphocyte or small lymphoma cell
ddx.vs: Mature lymphocytes have clumped, condensed chromatin rather than the fine blastic chromatin seen here.

24052.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見同一手多根手指的指尖到遠端指節對稱性變黑、乾燥皺縮，與正常皮膚之間有清楚的分界線，屬於乾性壞疽，發生在肢端最冷的部位，符合冷凝集素病造成的末梢循環阻塞。
features: Black, dry, shriveled necrosis of the distal phalanges of several adjacent fingers
Sharp line of demarcation with peeling skin at the junction with viable tissue
Symmetric acral distribution affecting the coldest distal sites
Proximal skin intact without ulceration or purpura
24052.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows dry gangrene involving the distal portions of multiple fingers of one hand, with black, desiccated skin, a sharp demarcation line and desquamation at the border with viable tissue. The proximal fingers and hand are spared. This acral pattern reflects cold-induced intravascular red cell agglutination and microvascular occlusion. In a patient with cold agglutinin disease, findings are consistent with cold-induced acral necrosis; the diagnosis rests on laboratory confirmation (DAT positive for C3d, high-titer cold agglutinins).

ddx.vs: Also causes cold-induced acral necrosis, but is identified by a cryoprecipitate and monoclonal immunoglobulin with a negative C3d DAT and no hemolysis-related agglutination on smear.
These cause thrombotic necrosis often with retiform purpura beyond acral sites, and are identified by antiphospholipid antibodies or coagulopathy rather than cold agglutinins.
Scleroderma shows sclerodactyly, digital pitting and fingertip ulcers with autoantibodies (anti-centromere, anti-Scl-70) rather than cold agglutinins.
Occurs in septic shock on vasopressors and lacks a cold agglutinin titer.

23220.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球間有一條呈 U 字形折返、細長帶狀、充滿紫色顆粒且無細胞核的結構，寬度與血小板相近、長度數個紅血球直徑，這是循環中的前血小板（proplatelet），代表巨核細胞細胞質釋放血小板的中間型。
features: Elongated, ribbon-like anucleate strand of granular purple cytoplasm folded into a U/hairpin shape
Width similar to a single platelet with a beaded, granular texture along its length
Length spanning several red cell diameters
No nucleus or cell membrane outline of an intact cell
Scattered normal-sized individual platelets and normocytic, normochromic red cells in the background
23220.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and scattered individual platelets of normal size. A single elongated, anucleate, beaded strand of granular platelet cytoplasm folded into a hairpin configuration is present between red cells, measuring several red cell diameters in length. No intact megakaryocytes, blasts or organisms are identified. Findings are consistent with a circulating proplatelet, a megakaryocytic cytoplasmic extension undergoing platelet fragmentation.

ddx.vs: Borrelia are thin, uniformly stained regularly coiled organisms, whereas a proplatelet is a thicker, beaded granular strand resembling linked platelets.
Microfilariae are much longer, with a sheath and a column of nuclei, unlike the anucleate granular proplatelet.
Clumps are aggregates of discrete platelets rather than one continuous elongated beaded strand.
Megakaryocytic fragments are larger irregular masses, sometimes containing nuclear material, not a slender ribbon.

22196.recognize_zh: 抹片中可見中至大型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍且邊緣有明顯的泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs/budding），部分似脫落成血小板碎片，是急性巨核母細胞白血病的典型線索。
features: Medium to large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs and pseudopod-like projections
Some blasts show a paler granular central cytoplasm and a basophilic agranular rim
Blasts occur singly and in small loose aggregates
Small dark nucleated cells and scattered platelets in the background; no Auer rods seen
22196.describe_en: Smear (source not specified; peripheral blood or aspirate) shows numerous medium-to-large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and moderate amounts of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. Many blasts display conspicuous cytoplasmic blebs and budding projections. Auer rods are not identified. Findings are suggestive of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia; confirmation requires flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry for CD41, CD61 or CD42b, and marrow fibrosis often necessitates a core biopsy.

ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clusters and are negative for CD41/CD61 and CD45 on immunophenotyping.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without blebs and express TdT and B- or T-lineage markers.
Erythroid blasts also have deeply basophilic cytoplasm, so E-cadherin and glycophorin versus CD61 staining separates them.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of a myeloproliferative neoplasm
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblastic blast phase has a preceding MPN history and a driver mutation (JAK2, CALR or MPL).

19636.recognize_zh: 這是一張流程圖（非型態圖）：由疑似 AL 類澱粉沉積症的臨床線索（眼周紫斑、巨舌等）出發，依序為組織切片 Congo red 確診與分型、找出漿細胞克隆、評估器官侵犯與分期，最後依 NT-proBNP 與體能狀態分成低、中、高風險治療。
features: Top row clinical photos: periorbital purpura, submandibular/neck swelling, and macroglossia with tongue indentation

Side boxes list signs and symptoms of AL (fatigue, weight loss, edema, heart failure, neuropathy, postural hypotension, purpura) and red flags in MGUS/myeloma (unexplained high NT-proBNP, albuminuria)
Diagnostic steps: tissue biopsy with Congo red, amyloid typing by IHC or LC-MS, then clone detection by serum/urine immunofixation, free light chains, marrow biopsy, iFISH, and imaging
Staging step: ECG, echocardiogram, NT-proBNP, troponin T, eGFR, 24-hour proteinuria, alkaline phosphatase, clotting

Risk-adapted therapy: low risk (consider ASCT with high-dose melphalan), intermediate risk (combination such as MDex, CTD, CyBorD, BMDex), high risk with NT-proBNP >8500 ng/L (dose-attenuated regimens with close monitoring)
19636.describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic diagnostic and treatment algorithm for suspected systemic AL amyloidosis. Clinical clues such as periorbital purpura, macroglossia, and unexplained NT-proBNP elevation or albuminuria in MGUS/myeloma prompt tissue confirmation with Congo red and amyloid typing by immunohistochemistry or mass spectrometry. The plasma cell clone is then characterized by serum and urine immunofixation, free light chains, bone marrow biopsy with iFISH, and imaging, followed by staging of organ involvement with cardiac biomarkers, echocardiography, and renal and hepatic parameters. Treatment is stratified by performance status, troponin T, and NT-proBNP into low-risk (autologous transplant candidates), intermediate-risk (combination chemotherapy), and high-risk (NT-proBNP >8500 ng/L, dose-attenuated therapy) groups.

18484.recognize_zh: 這是兩組 Kaplan-Meier 存活曲線（非形態學影像），顯示濾泡性淋巴瘤自體移植後的整體存活依先前治療線數分層：先前治療越少（1 線或 2 線）存活越好，3 線以上者存活明顯較差。
features: Panel A: survival probability over 14 years by 1 regimen, 2 regimens, and 3 or more prior regimens
Panel A: 3 or more regimens curve drops to about 40% by 5 years, versus about 60% for 1 regimen at 7-8 years
Panel B: survival (%) over 20 years for 2 therapies (n=44), 3 therapies (n=35), and more than 3 therapies (n=42)
Panel B: long-term survival about 55-65% with 2 therapies, about 45% with 3, and about 25% with more than 3
Censoring tick marks and stepwise curves typical of Kaplan-Meier analysis
18484.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure presents two Kaplan-Meier analyses of overall survival after autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation for follicular lymphoma, stratified by the number of prior treatment regimens. In both cohorts, survival decreases progressively with more prior lines of therapy: patients transplanted after one or two regimens have substantially better long-term survival than those receiving three or more regimens. The interpretation is that autologous transplantation is most effective when used earlier in the disease course, before the development of chemoresistance.

15796.recognize_zh: APL 病人接受 ATRA 治療後，肘部出現紅色丘疹與融合的水腫性紅斑塊；皮膚切片可見真皮內瀰漫的中性球與骨髓系細胞浸潤，沒有血管炎，類似 Sweet 症候群的嗜中性皮膚病。
features: Panel A (clinical): erythematous, edematous papules coalescing into a juicy, vesiculopustular-appearing plaque over the elbow with satellite papules
Panel B (H&E, low-medium power): dense dermal infiltrate between collagen bundles composed of neutrophils and mononuclear myeloid cells
Panel C (high power): interstitial cells with lobulated/bilobed and indented nuclei dissecting through collagen
Papillary dermal edema and absence of an obvious leukocytoclastic vasculitis at this resolution
No epidermal changes of a drug-induced interface reaction visible in the sections
15796.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows erythematous, edematous papules and a coalescent plaque with a pseudovesicular surface over the elbow on day 18 of ATRA-based induction. The skin biopsy shows a dense interstitial and perivascular dermal infiltrate of neutrophils and maturing myeloid cells with lobulated and indented nuclei dissecting between collagen bundles, with dermal edema. Definite vasculitis is not seen at this image resolution. Findings are consistent with an ATRA-associated neutrophilic dermatosis (Sweet syndrome-like reaction); differentiating leukemic infiltrates (leukemia cutis of maturing APL cells) should be excluded with MPO/CD117 and PML::RARA studies where needed.

ddx.vs: Leukemia cutis shows monotonous atypical promyelocytes or blasts rather than a mixed infiltrate of mature neutrophils, and may harbor PML::RARA in the lesional cells.
Morbilliform drug eruptions show sparse perivascular lymphocytes and eosinophils with interface change rather than a dense neutrophilic dermal infiltrate.
LCV presents as palpable purpura with fibrinoid necrosis of small vessel walls and nuclear dust, which is not the dominant finding here.
Infection may show abscess formation and organisms on Gram, PAS or GMS stains and positive cultures, especially in neutropenic patients.

3188.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被一群大小相近的中大型單核細胞取代，核圓至略凹陷、染色質細緻並有小核仁，細胞質中等量淡藍色、顆粒不明顯，外觀近似單核球性白血病；需靠 CD56+、sCD3− 的免疫表型與 EBV 才能確認為侵襲性 NK 細胞白血病。
features: Monotonous population of intermediate to large mononuclear cells replacing the aspirate
Round to slightly indented or folded nuclei with fine, dispersed chromatin and small visible nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale blue-grey cytoplasm; azurophilic granules not evident at this magnification
Occasional cells with slightly irregular nuclear outlines resembling monocytic cells
Few residual normal elements, including small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors
3188.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a monotonous infiltrate of intermediate to large mononuclear cells with round to indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm without conspicuous granules. The cells resemble monoblasts or promonocytes, and residual hematopoiesis is sparse. Morphology alone cannot establish the lineage. In conjunction with flow cytometry showing CD2+, surface CD3-, cytoplasmic CD3E+ and CD56+ cells with EBV positivity, the findings are consistent with aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts are MPO weak/negative but nonspecific esterase positive and express CD14, CD64 and CD11b, and they lack cytoplasmic CD3E and EBER.
BPDCN is CD4+/CD56+/CD123+/TCF4+ with negative cytotoxic markers and EBER, and often presents with skin lesions.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: It consists of small mature granular lymphocytes with an indolent course, unlike the large atypical cells with fulminant presentation here.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma with leukemic spread
ddx.vs: It has a similar phenotype and EBV status, but it presents with a dominant nasal or extranodal mass rather than primary marrow and blood disease.

3316.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑之間的造血組織被一片細胞密集、帶纖維化、梭形排列的浸潤取代（右側），左側仍殘留含出血的正常骨髓；此倍率看不出個別 hallmark cell，需高倍與 CD30/ALK 染色證實 ALCL 侵犯。
features: Low-power bone marrow core with several bony trabeculae
Diffuse replacement of the intertrabecular space (right) by a hypercellular infiltrate with a fibrotic, streaming spindle-cell pattern
Residual hematopoietic marrow with hemorrhage and scattered fat on the left
No normal fat-to-cellularity architecture within the involved area
Individual cytologic features of tumor cells not resolvable at this magnification
3316.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows several bony trabeculae with a hypercellular intertrabecular space that is extensively replaced, particularly on the right, by a dense infiltrate with associated fibrosis and a streaming, spindled pattern. Residual hematopoietic marrow with hemorrhage is present on the left. The cytology of the infiltrating cells cannot be assessed at this magnification, and fibrosis may cause a dry tap aspirate. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by lymphoma, in keeping with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pending high-power review and CD30/ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.dx: Primary myelofibrosis or other fibrotic myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows clustered atypical megakaryocytes and streaming hematopoietic cells, without a population of large CD30/ALK-positive neoplastic cells.
These are keratin- or mesenchymal-marker positive and negative for CD30, ALK and CD45.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with marrow fibrosis
ddx.vs: Hodgkin involvement shows scattered large CD15+/CD30+ cells in a mixed inflammatory fibrotic background and is ALK negative.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular fibrotic aggregates of spindled mast cells that are CD117/tryptase positive and CD25 positive.

2612.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁有一個由淡粉紅色上皮樣組織球組成的緊密肉芽腫，周圍圍繞一圈小淋巴球，中央沒有壞死，左下方另有第二個肉芽腫，符合非乾酪性肉芽腫（non-necrotizing granuloma）的類肉瘤病骨髓侵犯。
features: Well-formed non-necrotizing granuloma adjacent to a bony trabecula
Epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei
Dense cuff of small lymphocytes surrounding the granuloma
Second, less well-defined granuloma at the lower left
Surrounding marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, megakaryocytes and fat spaces; no necrosis
2612.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows a well-formed, non-necrotizing epithelioid granuloma abutting a bony trabecula, surrounded by a cuff of small lymphocytes, with a second granuloma at the lower left. The epithelioid histiocytes have pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei; no caseous necrosis is seen. The remaining marrow shows preserved trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes and adipose tissue. Findings are consistent with non-necrotizing granulomatous inflammation, compatible with sarcoidosis after special stains and cultures exclude infection.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas often show central caseous necrosis and AFB-positive organisms or positive cultures.
Fungal granulomas may contain yeasts visible on GMS/PAS stains and occur in immunocompromised hosts.
Hodgkin involvement shows Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background, often with fibrosis.
Lipogranulomas are small aggregates of histiocytes around fat vacuoles, lacking well-formed epithelioid morphology.

4724.recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血液中可見一顆有核紅血球（NRBC），並有大小不一的紅血球與略大的多染性紅血球；另有深藍色不規則物質疊在紅血球上，性質不確定。單一高倍視野中溶血證據有限，需搭配 DAT 與臨床。
features: Nucleated red blood cell with a round dense nucleus and a small rim of cytoplasm
Irregular deep-blue clumped material overlying or adjacent to red cells, of uncertain nature (possibly platelets or stain precipitate)
Anisocytosis with some larger pale polychromatophilic red cells
Occasional small round red cells with reduced central pallor
Stain precipitate/debris at the upper left edge of the field
4724.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a nucleated red blood cell with a round, dense nucleus. The red cells show anisocytosis, including larger pale polychromatophilic cells and occasional small round cells with reduced central pallor. Irregular deep-blue clumped material lies over several red cells, including one with a small dark dot; its nature is uncertain in this image and may represent overlying platelets or stain precipitate. The findings of circulating nucleated red cells and polychromasia can be seen in hemolytic disease of the newborn, but the field alone is limited and correlation with the direct antiglobulin test, maternal antibody screen and bilirubin is needed.

ddx.dx: ABO hemolytic disease of the newborn
ddx.vs: ABO HDN typically shows more numerous microspherocytes with a weak or negative DAT, whereas RhD HDN has fewer spherocytes and a strongly positive DAT with anti-D.
Healthy newborns can have a few circulating NRBCs in the first days of life, without significant anemia, hyperbilirubinemia or a positive DAT.
HS shows spherocytes with a negative DAT and a family history, while alloimmune HDN has a positive DAT.
Congenital infection can cause NRBCs and hemolysis but is DAT negative and usually accompanied by thrombocytopenia and hepatosplenomegaly.

1268.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中明顯的淋巴球增多，細胞中等大小，核圓、部分可見單一明顯核仁，胞質中等量淡藍、有些邊緣不規則或有細突起；兼具「毛狀胞質」與「前淋巴球樣明顯核仁」是毛狀細胞白血病變異型（HCL-v）的線索，且白血球數高、不像典型 HCL 會單核球減少。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis of medium-sized lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; some with a single distinct central nucleolus
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, several cells with irregular borders or fine villous projections
Occasional larger cells with folded nuclei
Background red cells normocytic; a nucleated red cell and no monocytes evident at this power
1268.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low to intermediate power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and, in many cells, a single distinct nucleolus. The cytoplasm is moderate and pale blue, with irregular borders or fine villous projections in a subset of cells. Fine nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. The combination of hairy cytoplasmic projections, prolymphocyte-like nucleoli and a high circulating count is suggestive of hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli in WHO 5th edition), which should be confirmed by flow cytometry showing CD11c and CD103 positivity with CD25 and annexin A1 negativity and absence of BRAF V600E.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL presents with leukopenia and monocytopenia and cells lack prominent nucleoli, and it is CD25+, CD123+, annexin A1+ and BRAF V600E-mutated.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / splenic lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes have similar prominent nucleoli but smooth cytoplasmic borders without villous projections and are usually CD103-negative.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have short polar projections and smaller nuclei without prominent nucleoli, and are CD103-negative.
MCL cells can have nucleoli but have irregular nuclear contours without villi and are CD5+ with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.

1076.recognize_zh: 骨髓顆粒的基質條帶旁排列著許多核偏位、細胞質藍色並有核周淡染區的漿細胞，並夾雜深藍黑色含鐵血黃素顆粒，呈現漿細胞沿血管/基質分布的樣子。
features: Stromal strand/particle with numerous plasma cells aligned along it
Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Scattered dark blue-black granular pigment consistent with hemosiderin in stromal macrophages
Occasional binucleate plasma cell and a plasma cell with a small nucleolus
Surrounding blood background with red cells and few nucleated cells
1076.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a stromal strand from a marrow particle along which numerous plasma cells are arranged. The plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hofs. Dark blue-black granular pigment consistent with hemosiderin is present within the stroma. Plasma cells are normally located around vessels and stroma; quantitation and light-chain studies are needed to determine whether this plasmacytosis is reactive or neoplastic.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows sheets or clusters of monotypic plasma cells, often with atypia, and usually more than 10% of marrow cells.
Reactive plasma cells are perivascular, cytologically mature, and polytypic by kappa/lambda staining.
LPL includes a large small-lymphocyte and plasmacytoid lymphocyte component with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein.

4212.recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下正常濾泡與竇結構完全消失，被瀰漫單調的淋巴樣細胞取代，浸潤延伸至被膜；此倍率只能看出結構破壞，ATLL 的診斷需高倍細胞學、免疫表型與 HTLV-1 檢測。
features: Complete effacement of nodal architecture by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate
No residual follicles or open sinuses identified
Monotonous cellular infiltrate with scattered vessels
Infiltrate abuts and focally involves the capsule
Cytologic detail not assessable at this low magnification
4212.describe_en: Low-power view of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of the normal architecture by a sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate, with no residual follicles or patent sinuses. The infiltrate extends up to the capsule. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. The pattern indicates a diffuse lymphoma; combined with high-power morphology, a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype and HTLV-1 positivity, findings are consistent with nodal adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS has a similar diffuse pattern and is distinguished by absence of HTLV-1 infection.
DLBCL also effaces the node but consists of large B cells expressing CD20/PAX5.
Reactive nodes preserve follicles, sinuses and a polymorphous paracortex.

4148.recognize_zh: 一個大濾泡內含多個小型退化生發中心（twinning），外圍套區小淋巴球呈同心圓洋蔥皮排列，生發中心淡染富含血管與濾泡樹突細胞，濾泡間血管增生；這些都是透明血管型 Castleman 病的低倍線索。
features: Enlarged follicle containing multiple small regressed germinal centers (twinning)
Germinal centers pale, hyalinized and vascular, depleted of lymphocytes
Expanded mantle zone with concentric onion-skin arrangement of small lymphocytes
Increased interfollicular hyalinized vessels
No atypical cell sheets or effacement by a monotonous population
4148.describe_en: Lymph node section at low-to-medium power shows an enlarged follicle harboring multiple small, pale, regressed germinal centers within a single expanded mantle zone. The mantle lymphocytes are arranged in concentric onion-skin layers, and the germinal centers are depleted of lymphocytes and rich in vessels and dendritic cells. The interfollicular region contains increased hyalinized vessels. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: FL follicles have BCL2-positive germinal centers of centrocytes and centroblasts with attenuated rather than expanded onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell variant / idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Plasma cell type has sheets of interfollicular plasma cells with hyperplastic rather than atretic germinal centers.
Reactive follicles have active germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and polarization, not twinning with atretic centers.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mantle cells are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and monoclonal.

3956.recognize_zh: 紅血球普遍偏小、中央淡染區擴大（低色素性），大小與形狀差異明顯，有靶形細胞、橢圓形與淚滴狀紅血球，右上還有一顆偏藍的多染性紅血球，這些組合符合地中海型貧血（thalassemia）的紅血球形態。
features: Microcytic hypochromic red cells with enlarged central pallor
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, elliptocytes, teardrop cells and small fragments
Mixture of hypochromic cells and some better-hemoglobinized cells
A single polychromatophilic red cell (upper right)
No nucleated red cells or basophilic stippling clearly seen in this field
3956.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a predominance of microcytic, hypochromic red cells with marked anisopoikilocytosis, including target cells, elliptocytes, teardrop forms and small fragments. A polychromatophilic red cell is present, while nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. The degree of poikilocytosis is disproportionate to what would be expected in iron deficiency of similar severity. Findings are consistent with thalassemia; correlation with red cell indices (low MCV with relatively high RBC count), iron studies and hemoglobin HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows pencil cells and fewer target cells with a low RBC count and low ferritin, whereas thalassemia has prominent targets, normal iron stores and an elevated RBC count relative to MCV.
Anemia of chronic disease is usually only mildly microcytic with little poikilocytosis and few target cells.
Sideroblastic anemia shows a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in the marrow.
Morphology overlaps with target cells; HPLC or electrophoresis identifies the abnormal hemoglobin variant.

3828.recognize_zh: 高倍下這顆大型組織球的細胞質布滿大小均一的圓形透明空泡，呈泡沫或桑椹狀，核小、偏心，沒有 Gaucher 細胞的皺紙狀紋理，是典型 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞。
features: Large round histiocyte roughly three to four times the diameter of an adjacent neutrophil
Cytoplasm uniformly packed with small, round, clear vacuoles giving a foamy/mulberry texture
Single small, irregular, eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; low N:C ratio
No fibrillary striations and no blue-green granules
Adjacent band/metamyelocyte neutrophils and red cells for size reference
3828.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate shows a large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm distended by numerous uniform, sharply outlined clear vacuoles and a small eccentric nucleus. The cytoplasm is not striated and lacks sea-blue granules. Neighboring granulocytic precursors are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a Niemann-Pick (lipid-laden foam) cell.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells show fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm instead of discrete round vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granular material, which is absent in this pale vacuolated cell.

ddx.dx: Foamy macrophage secondary to lipid overload or storage of other type (e.g., Wolman/CESD)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so diagnosis requires enzyme activity (acid sphingomyelinase, acid lipase) or genetic testing.

3636.recognize_zh: 中央兩顆淋巴球細胞核呈腦迴狀（cerebriform）的深摺與溝紋，細胞質極少，另右側一顆也有類似摺皺核，就是 Sézary 細胞；旁邊的正常小淋巴球核平滑可作比較。背景紅血球呈棘狀皺縮，屬抹片乾燥假象。
features: Atypical lymphocytes with markedly convoluted, cerebriform nuclei showing deep grooves and folds
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Dense to moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Size ranges from small to large (comparable to or larger than a normal small lymphocyte)
Adjacent normal small lymphocyte with smooth nuclear contour and a neutrophil for comparison
Background crenated RBCs (echinocytes), likely drying artifact
3636.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several atypical lymphoid cells with markedly convoluted, cerebriform nuclei bearing deep grooves, scant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli. These cells range from small to large, and contrast with an adjacent small lymphocyte with a smooth nuclear outline and a segmented neutrophil. Background red cells show diffuse crenation, most consistent with artifact. Findings are consistent with circulating Sézary cells; correlation with erythroderma and flow cytometry (e.g., CD4:CD8 >10, loss of CD7/CD26) is recommended.

ddx.vs: ATLL cells show polylobated 'flower' nuclei with petal-like lobes rather than finely grooved cerebriform nuclei, and are HTLV-1 positive.
T-PLL cells have a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with much higher counts and TCL1 overexpression.
Occasional reactive or normal lymphocytes may be slightly indented, but lack a population of deeply convoluted cells and immunophenotypic aberrancy.

3700.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度極高，脂肪空泡很少；大片中型未成熟細胞核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻，取代正常造血，其間夾雜深染小圓核的紅血球系細胞與數顆巨核細胞。移植後出現這種未成熟細胞片狀浸潤，要考慮 AML 復發。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with few small fat spaces
Diffuse sheets of medium-sized immature cells with oval to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Interspersed clusters of small erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
Scattered megakaryocytes, including a smaller form with a hypolobated nucleus and a large lobulated form
Occasional eosinophilic granulocytes; no fibrosis assessable on H&E
3700.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat. Much of the space is occupied by sheets of medium-sized immature mononuclear cells with oval to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with erythroid clusters, occasional eosinophilic granulocytes and scattered megakaryocytes, some small and hypolobated. Blast quantification is not possible on H&E alone. In a patient after peripheral stem cell transplant, findings are consistent with recurrent acute myeloid leukemia; CD34/CD117 immunohistochemistry, aspirate differential and chimerism analysis are recommended.

ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows orderly maturing myeloid and erythroid islands and normal megakaryocytes without sheets of CD34+ blasts.
CML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with a full maturation spectrum and small 'dwarf' megakaryocytes, confirmed by BCR::ABL1 testing.

ddx.dx: Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder or ALL relapse
ddx.vs: Lymphoid infiltrates lack admixed myeloid features and are distinguished by CD19/PAX5 or CD3 versus MPO/CD117 immunostaining.

3572.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆顆粒球，核只分成兩個圓形葉、中間細橋相連（像夾鼻眼鏡，pince-nez），染色質非常粗糙緻密；這種假性 Pelger-Huët 核是顆粒球系發育不良的經典線索。
features: Neutrophil with bilobed pince-nez nucleus (pseudo-Pelger-Huët)
Markedly coarse, condensed chromatin in both lobes
Cytoplasm with fine granules, somewhat pale
Myelocyte at left with round nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm
Immature myeloid cells at the edges; RBCs with drying artifact
3572.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a neutrophil with a bilobed, pince-nez nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin bridge and very coarsely clumped chromatin. Nearby are a myelocyte and other granulocytic precursors, and the red cells show drying artifact. The pseudo-Pelger-Huët nucleus is a feature of dysgranulopoiesis. In the absence of a hereditary Pelger-Huët anomaly or drug exposure, this supports a myelodysplastic process when present in at least 10% of granulocytes.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias.
Identical morphology can occur with these drugs, and it is separated by medication history and resolution after withdrawal.
Band nuclei are curved and uniform in width without two round lobes connected by a thin filament.

3444.recognize_zh: 中央白血球（分葉核、細胞質含顆粒）的周圍與細胞質邊緣聚集許多紫色小血小板，部分似已被吞入細胞質內，呈現白血球吞噬血小板；背景中可見棘狀（crenated）紅血球。
features: Leukocyte with lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm at center
Numerous small platelets clustered on the cytoplasmic surface and around the cell, some appearing internalized
Loose aggregate of platelets adjacent to the leukocyte
Background red cells normochromic with scattered echinocytes (crenated cells), likely storage/EDTA artifact
Few free platelets elsewhere in the field
3444.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with scattered crenated forms. A granulated leukocyte with a lobulated nucleus is associated with a cluster of platelets, several of which appear to lie within or overlapping its cytoplasm, while others adhere to its surface. Free platelets are otherwise relatively sparse. Findings are consistent with leukocyte phagocytosis of platelets with associated platelet adherence; overlap with platelet satellitism should be considered, and a citrate-anticoagulated or fingerstick smear may help exclude an in vitro artifact causing pseudothrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Satellitism shows a rosette of platelets rimming the neutrophil membrane without internalization, typically in EDTA blood.
Platelet clumps are free-standing aggregates not centered on or ingested by a leukocyte.
Morulae are single intracytoplasmic mulberry-like clusters of basophilic organisms rather than multiple discrete platelets.

2740.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液中白血球明顯增加，幾乎都是型態一致的中小型淋巴細胞，細胞質少而偏嗜鹼性、邊緣不規則，只有少數嗜中性球；這種顯著的單一形態淋巴球增多，符合 T-PLL 常見的高白血球淋巴球增多。
features: Marked lymphocytosis at low power with numerous monotonous lymphoid cells
Small to intermediate cells with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Irregular cell outlines suggesting cytoplasmic protrusions
Dense nuclear chromatin; fine nuclear detail limited at this magnification
Few neutrophils; red cells without significant poikilocytosis; no smudge cells prominent
2740.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked leukocytosis composed predominantly of a monotonous population of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, dense chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm with irregular outlines. Neutrophils are few, and smudge cells are not prominent. Nuclear detail and nucleoli cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a lymphoproliferative disorder such as T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the given context; high-power review, flow cytometry and TCL1A studies are needed.

ddx.vs: CLL typically shows numerous smudge cells and small round lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
Leukemic MCL cells are cyclin D1-positive CD5+ B cells, often with more nuclear irregularity and no cytoplasmic blebs.
Sezary cells show cerebriform nuclei at high power and a CD4+/CD7-negative phenotype with skin involvement.

2420.recognize_zh: 血片中多個異常細胞的核有摺痕或呈雙葉狀，細胞質帶細小、稀疏的顆粒而非粗大顆粒，高核質比，這種核型態搭配缺乏明顯顆粒的細胞質要想到低顆粒型 APL（M3v）。
features: Medium to large cells with high to moderate N:C ratio
Nuclei folded, indented or bilobed with overlapping lobes
Fine, delicate chromatin; small inconspicuous nucleoli
Basophilic to gray-blue cytoplasm with very fine, sparse granules; some cells appear agranular
Irregular cytoplasmic borders with small blebs
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets sparse
2420.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous atypical medium-to-large cells with folded, indented to bilobed nuclei, fine chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderately basophilic with only fine, sparse granules, and several cells appear nearly agranular; Auer rods are not evident in this field. Platelets are sparse.
